field_notes.source: 'Base game', 'Shadow of the Erdtree' (DLC) or 'Tarnished Pack' (DLC), from the DLC icon next to the item in the wiki gallery.
field_notes.summary: Opening paragraph of the wiki page (often contains exact values, e.g. talisman percentages).
field_notes.effect / effect_details / effect_tables: Infobox effect line + content of the page's Effect/Usage sections.
field_notes.infobox: All infobox fields of the page, cleaned (numbers parsed when purely numeric).
field_notes.acquisition: method / location / region / details from the Acquisition section; nested bullets prefixed with '→'.
field_notes.other_sections: Remaining gameplay sections (text bullets and tables); Trivia/Gallery/References are excluded.

items.name: Commoner's Headband
items.summary: Commoner's Headband is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A headband that holds cloth in place.

Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about
them.

details: Found on top of the head of a serpent statue in Volcano Manor, after the Temple of Eiglay grace.

notes: Despite having an altered version you cannot alter the Commoner's Headband through Boc the Seamster or the use of Tailoring Tools.

items.name: Commoner's Headband (altered)
items.summary: Commoner's Headband (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A headband with the cloth removed. Standard wear for
commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about
them.

details: Chance to drop from Commoner enemies. Cannot be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Aristocrat Headband
items.summary: Aristocrat Headband is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Valuable headband featuring fine goldwork. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

details: Chance to drop from the Sorcerer Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. Two can be found in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One to the east up the hill and one along the road to the north. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass while heading to both groups will allow the Tarnished to kill them uncontested.

items.name: Aristocrat Hat
items.summary: Aristocrat Hat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leather hat decorated with a withered feather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

details: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two following a torch bearer immediately north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Cowl
items.summary: Old Aristocrat Cowl is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Cowl made of soft cloth. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.
Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

details: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

items.name: Page Hood
items.summary: Page Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown nature.

details: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

items.name: High Page Hood
items.summary: High Page Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood of a page selected for special privileges by the noble
they serve.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen
and unknown stature.

details: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Guardian Mask
items.summary: Guardian Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Engraved golden mask. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

details: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

items.name: Festive Hood
items.summary: Festive Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village
of windmills.

Decorated with many-colored flowers.

details: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Festive Hood (Altered)
items.summary: Festive Hood (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. It is the altered form of the Festive Hood.
items.description:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village
of windmills.

Decorated with many-colored flowers.

details: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

items.name: Blue Festive Hood
items.summary: Blue Festive Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

details: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Guilty Hood
items.summary: Guilty Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown.

The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by
the collar of sharpened branches.

details: Found on a corpse in a ditch near the Avenue Balcony site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
Sold by the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir) for 500 runes.

items.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
items.summary:
Prisoner Iron Mask is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prisoner Set.
items.description:
Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.
Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling.

A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly
fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that
is near indistinguishable from it.

details: Starting gear for the Prisoner class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

items.name: Blackguard's Iron Mask
items.summary: Blackguard's Iron Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Iron mask forced on convicted prisoners. Worn by the blackguard Big Boggart.

To Boggart, the mask made him all the more threatening, and helped him get what he wanted. But it was also a mirror of his emptiness.

details: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart.

items.name: Bloodsoaked Mask
items.summary: Bloodsoaked Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood.

Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

details: Found on a corpse near the Underground Roadside site of grace located in the sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Caterpillar Mask
items.summary: Caterpillar Mask is is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Grotesque mask constructed from countless solidified caterpillars. A ritual implement of the greater potentates of Bonny Village.

Used to ward off thoughts of impurity, doubt, temptation, and other wickednesses one is vulnerable to while absorbed in divine ritual.

acquisition.location: from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:
details: Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him.
→ This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.
→ Their signs will then become available to choose between at the top of the staircase found northeast of the Main Gate Plaza site of grace.
→ This option becomes inaccessible after defeating Messmer the Impaler.
Ancient Ruins of Rauh - If the player chooses to summon the Hornsent in the fight against Messmer.
→ The Hornsent will then invade the player at the top of the staircase in one of the rot-infested halls near the Church of the Bud in the southwestern quarters of Rauh.
→ Defeating him here will yield the player this item.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to defeat Messmer without the Hornsent's assistance.
→ The Hornsent will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his corpse, which can then be found in the arena after the battle is over.

notes: This item is part of the Hornsent Set.

items.name: Black Dumpling
items.summary: Black Dumpling is a helm found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty. It magnifies one's fears and makes them acutely aware of all forms of pain.

Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness.

When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

details: Chance to drop from the crawling First-Generation Albinaurics that wear it around the Prison Town of the Volcano Manor or in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: Increases damage by 10% for 20 seconds when someone within 7 meters of the wearer is afflicted with Madness, including the wearer themself.

items.name: Mushroom Head
items.summary: Mushroom Head is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the head.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestements that root one to the earth.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Mushroom Crown
items.summary:
Mushroom Crown is a helm found in Elden Ring.

It's one of the possible head pieces for the Mushroom Set.
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece.

Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot.

Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

details: Found on a corpse on top of a pillar in some ruins in the southeastern part of Lake of Rot.

notes: Increases damage by 10% for 20 seconds when someone within 7 meters of the wearer is afflicted with Poison or Scarlet Rot, including the wearer themself.

items.name: St. Trina's Blossom
items.japanese_name: トリーナの一花 (Torīna no Hitohana)
items.summary: St. Trina's Blossom is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
St. Trina's life withered and fell, as fleeting as the seasons. At her last, she left a single water lily.

Slightly boosts max FP.

Despite the velvety-purple hue, the flower is in no way poisonous—it merely blooms in quietude.
effect_details: Increases max FP by +6%.

details: Found at the feet of St. Trina's withered flower body after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

notes: St. Trina's Blossom is not part of any armor set.

items.name: Circlet of Light
items.summary: Circlet of Light is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The circlet of light which adorned Miquella's head as he returned in divine aspect. It has begun to fade into nothingness.

Slightly boosts intelligence, faith, and arcane, while also boosting the power of Miquella's light.

This circle was to be the very foundation upon which Miquella's age of compassion would be built, should it have ever come to pass.
effect_details: Raises the following attributes:
→ +1 Intelligence
→ +1 Faith
→ +1 Arcane
+10% attack power of Light of Miquella

details: Automatically acquired from touching the memory of Miquella after having defeated Promised Consort Radahn. The memory can be found on the floor in the middle of the arena.

infobox.effects:
*Slightly raises intelligence
*Slightly raises faith
*Slightly raises arcane
*Boosts the Light of Miquella incantation

items.name: Astrologer Hood
items.summary:
Astrologer Hood is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Astrologer Set.
items.description:
Hood fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

details: Starting gear for the Astrologer class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
items.summary: Juvenile Scholar Cap is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Cap worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew
by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria
Academy.

Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they
repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory
fades into oblivion.

details: Complete the "Resurrection" Painting from the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes. The location of the painter's spirit is the graveyard south of Caria Manor.

items.name: Karolos Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Karolos Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's one of the possible headpieces for the Glintstone Sorcerer Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria
scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence to the detriment of stamina.

The Karolos Conspectus is the oldest of the academy's lineages
of study, begat by the sorcerer Azur. Scholars who follow in his
footsteps pursue the mysteries of comets.

details: Dropped by a Crystal Crab found by taking a left after the fountain after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, and then keeping to the left after passing under the bridge.

notes: Grants +3 Intelligence in exchange for a 9% penalty to Stamina.
→ This Stamina penalty is generally effectively the same as a -6 to Endurance for the purpose calculating total Stamina, growing larger as the wearer's Endurance increases.

Generally one of the better Glintstone Crowns, after the Haima and Hierodas ones. This is mostly because the HP penalties of the remaining Crowns is a far harsher downside than this one's Stamina penalty, and because the Witch's Glintstone Crown's even larger Stamina penalty in exchange for a relatively small bonus is far harsher.

items.name: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Olivinus Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's one of the possible headpieces for the Glintstone Sorcerer Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP.

The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

details: Found on a body reached by taking a left after the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace and going through an illusory wall, then jumping over the railing to the left and climbing a series of rocks at the end of that path.

notes: Grants +3 Intelligence in exchange for -9% HP.
→ This HP penalty is effectively the same as a -2 to Vigor at 20 Vigor, a -3 to Vigor at 40 Vigor, and a -9 to Vigor at 60 Vigor.

Fairly worth it early on for Sorcerers due to the boost to Intelligence coming with a relatively minor penalty, but after 40 Vigor the penalty becomes steeper and steeper and it becomes advisable to switch it for something like the Karolos, Hierodas, or Queen's Crescent Crowns.

items.name: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Twinsage Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's one of the possible headpieces for the Glintstone Sorcerer Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina.

Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kind.

details: Dropped by a Crystal Crab found to the side of a building reached after climbing across the rooftops to the left after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace.

→ After starting at the rooftops, climb up the ladder to the first tower then drop down on the right at the end, and drop down on the right again and take the right to drop down on a second tower. Continue around and jump over to the roof of the Church of the Cuckoo Site of Grace, then drop down on the walkway outside of it to the right and go around to the right.
→ Can also be reached by climbing the ladder shortcut at the Church of the Cuckoo Site of Grace and taking the bridge to go outside from the second floor, then head around on the right.

notes: Grants a +6 to Intelligence in exchange for a -9% to both HP and Stamina.
→ This Stamina penalty is generally effectively the same as a -6 to Endurance for the purpose calculating total Stamina, growing larger as the wearer's Endurance increases.
→ This HP penalty is effectively the same as a -2 to Vigor at 20 Vigor, a -3 to Vigor at 40 Vigor, and a -9 to Vigor at 60 Vigor.

Fairly worth it early on for Sorcerers due to the large boost to Intelligence coming with relatively manageable penalties, but after 40 Vigor the HP penalty becomes steeper and steeper and it becomes advisable to switch it for something like the Karolos, Hierodas, or Queen's Crescent Crowns.

items.name: Witch's Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Witch's Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's one of the possible headpieces for the Glintstone Sorcerer Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and arcane to the detriment of stamina.

This gentle-looking crown was granted to a scholar who excelled in her studies, which also merited the title of "witch".

details: Awarded upon completing Sellen's questline.
→ If Sellen is sided with and both Comet Azur and Stars of Ruin are acquired, it can be found on the ground near Sellen's position in the Grand Library (Rennala's arena) after she transforms.
→ If Witch-Hunter Jerren is sided with, it's awarded after defeating Sellen.

notes: Grants a +3 to both Intelligence and Arcane in exchange for a -18% to Stamina.
→ This Stamina penalty is generally effectively the same as a -6 to Endurance for the purpose calculating total Stamina when at 20 Endurance, or -18 when at 40 Endurance.

Overall no worth it due to the very large Stamina penalty, and because the combination of Intelligence and Arcane only really synergizes with the Albinauric Staff and Maternal Staff Shadow of the Erdtree.

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Lazuli Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of the Lazuli Sorcerer Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria
scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and dexterity to the detriment of HP.

Scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus study Carian sorceries—a
heterodox pursuit that views the moon as equal to the stars.

details: Dropped by a Crystal Crab inside a tower after jumping down two wooden platform after the top one, accessed via the rooftops found to the left after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in the academy.

→ From the starts of the rooftops climb up the ladder of the first tower, then drop of on the furthest right corner of the walkway's tower, then drop down to the right again, and finally jump across to a final rooftop with the tower on the right.

notes: Grants +3 to both Intelligence and Dexterity in exchange for a -18% to HP.
→ This HP penalty is effectively the same as a -4 to Vigor at 20 Vigor, a -6 to Vigor at 40 Vigor, and a -16 to Vigor at 60 Vigor.
While the bonus of this helmet is strong, the massive HP penalty makes it not really worth it even at low levels of Vigor and especially not at levels above 40.

items.name: Haima Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Haima Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of the Battlemage Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria
scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and strength to the detriment of FP.

Scholars of the Haima Conspectus sought the power to quell
conflict, and to this end studied the sorceries of cannon fire and
the gavel.

details: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

notes: Grants a +2 to both Intelligence and Strength, at a the cost of a 9% penalty to FP.
→ The FP penalty is effectively a -3 to Mind as long as your Mind is at 41 or below, meaning that this crown effectively grants +1 to stats when accounting for this penalty.

This is one of the strongest Glintstone Crowns, primarily due to its downside being easily ignorable with a bit of stat investment (though the Hierodas Glintstone Crown has more generally beneficial bonuses).
Unlike most other Glintstone Crowns the Erudition gesture won't make this Crown's crystal glow.

items.name: Hierodas Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Hierodas Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

Part of the Errant Sorcerer Set.
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria
scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and endurance to the detriment of FP.

The crown of Hierodas was granted to scholars who engaged in
nomadic study away from the academy.

details: Found on a corpse east of the southernmost houses in the village.

notes: Grants a +2 to both Intelligence and Endurance, at a the cost of a 9% penalty to FP.
→ The FP penalty is effectively a -3 to Mind as long as your Mind is at 41 or below, meaning that this crown effectively grants +1 to stats when accounting for this penalty.

This is arguably the strongest of the Glintstone Crowns, primarily due to its downside being easily ignorable with a bit of stat investment and the bonuses being usable for a very wide variety of builds.
Unlike most other Glintstone Crowns the Erudition gesture won't make this Crown's crystal glow.

items.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
items.summary: Spellblade's Pointed Hat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

details: Dropped by Sorcerer Rogier at the end of his questline.

notes: Increases Magic damage from Skills by 2%.

items.name: Alberich's Pointed Hat
items.summary: Alberich's Pointed Hat is a helm armor in Elden Ring
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner.

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthens thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

details: Alberich's Pointed Hat is found in the entry hall of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, located on the Altus Plateau.

notes: This item may be modified into Alberich's Pointed Hat (Altered).
Increases the damage of Thorn Sorceries by 6%.

items.name: Alberich's Pointed Hat (Altered)
items.summary: Alberich's Pointed Hat (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. It is the altered form of Alberich's Pointed Hat.
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

details: The non-altered version can be found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: Increases the damage of Thorn Sorceries by 6%.

items.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
items.summary:
Preceptor's Big Hat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's one of two possible pieces of headgear for the Preceptor's Set.
items.description:
Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

Increases mind to the detriment of stamina.

Glintstone sorcerers are the descendant of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

details: Found on Seluvis's body after giving Ranni the Witch the Fingerslayer Blade.

notes: Increases Mind by 3 but decreases Stamina by 9%.

items.name: Mask of Confidence
items.summary:
Mask of Confidence is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's one of the possible head pieces for the Preceptor's Set.
items.description:
Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread. Increases
arcane.

When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic
preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their
matters were to be kept strictly private.

details: After inverting the study hall with the Carian Inverted Statue, defeat the first 3 Fingercreepers and then take the left path when the walkway splits. Dropping down on the end of that left path and then turning around leads to a small nook with the item.

notes: Grants +3 to Arcane when worn.

items.name: Azur's Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Azur's Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of Azur's Set.
items.description:
Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.

This crown replaced Azur's brain and skull altogether, and now, removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains within raises the potency of Azur's primeval current sorceries at the cost of additional FP consumption.

details: Can be found on Azur's body along with the rest of the set, just north of the village, after Sellen's questline has been completed.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Comet and Glintstone Cometshard by 10%, and of Comet Azur by 15%, while increasing the FP cost of all Sorceries by 15%.
Worth it on nearly any build that uses Comet Azur, as that spell is usually paired with the Cerulean Hidden Tear to negate the cost and maximize damage anyway.
Worth considering on a build that heavily uses Comet or Glintstone Cometshard. While the FP-efficiency will be worse, the higher damage per cast can save some casts or allow for quicker kills.
Unlike most other Glintstone Crowns the Erudition gesture won't make this Crown's crystal glow.

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Crown
items.summary:
Lusat's Glintstone Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of Lusat's Set.
items.description:
The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current
sorcerer.

This crown replaced Lusat's brain and skull altogether, and now,
removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains
within raises the potency of Lusat's primeval current sorceries
at the cost of additional FP consumption.

details: Can be found on Lusat's body along with the rest of the set, in a pit near the end of the area, after Sellen's questline has been completed.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Glintstone Stars and Star Shower by 10%, and of Stars of Ruin by 15%, while increasing the FP cost of all Sorceries by 15%.
Worth considering on a build that heavily uses Star Shower. While the FP-efficiency will be worse, the higher damage per cast can save some casts or allow for quicker kills.
Unlike most other Glintstone Crowns the Erudition gesture won't make this Crown's crystal glow.

items.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
items.summary: Queen's Crescent Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A tall crown depicting the moon. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeated Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

notes: Increases Intelligence by +3 when worn.

items.name: Snow Witch Hat
items.summary: Snow Witch Hat is a helm armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery. Strengthens cold sorcery.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

details: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

notes: This hat is worn by Ranni the Witch.
Increases the damage of Ice Sorceries by 10%.

items.name: High Priest Hat
items.summary: High Priest Hat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The hat of Count Ymir, High Priest.

The circular design at the top represents the Greater Will and its lightless abyss, imparting increased intelligence and arcane to the wearer.

Though Count Ymir instructed Rellana in the sorcerous arts, he abandoned his allegiance to the moon.

"It was merely the closest of the celestial bodies. Nothing more."
effect_details: Raises the following attributes:
→ +1 intelligence
→ +1 arcane

details: Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.
→ To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral.
→ This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.
→ Vanquishing Jolan will then get Ymir to appear by the throne to challenge the player. Defeating Ymir will then reward the player with this item, among several others.

notes: This item is part of the High Priest Set.

items.name: Fia's Hood
items.summary: Fia's Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head. Worn by Fia,
the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from
her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk.

details: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D, Beholder of Death.

items.name: Prophet Blindfold
items.summary:
Prophet Blindfold is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prophet Set.
items.description:
Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were
persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just
close your eyes, and walk.

details: Starting gear for the Prophet class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

items.name: Traveling Maiden Hood
items.summary: Traveling Maiden Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Finger Maiden Fillet
items.summary: Finger Maiden Fillet is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Fillet worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their
guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought
together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Sage Hood
items.summary: Sage Hood is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A burgundy pointed hood. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

details: The Sage Hood is found on a body inside Stillwater Cave, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: This hat is worn by Sage Gowry.

items.name: Greathood
items.summary: Greathood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover. A burial
shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they
sought.

Increases intelligence and faith to the detriment of HP.

"Yes, surely this is the moon that young Rennala gazed upon."

details: Having seen "Sorcerer" Painting is required in order to get that item. Found on the ground after reaching the place that is depicted in the painting, on a bridge west of Mountaintops of the Giants.

notes: Increases both Intelligence and Faith by 2, at the cost of a 9% HP penalty.

→ The large HP penalty generally makes this head piece not really worth it at more than 40 Vigor, complicated further by how late it can be acquired. Instead, a more focused head piece with a penalty to Stamina or FP is more worth it since those can generally be countered with less of a stat investment.

→→ At 60 Vigor it will lower maximum health from 1900 to 1710, roughly the same amount of health as 50 Vigor. At 50 Vigor it will lower maximum health from 1704 to 1534, the same amount of health as 43 Vigor. At 40 Vigor it will lower maximum health from 1450 to 1305, the same amount of health as 37 Vigor.

→→ Good alternatives are the Hierodas Glintstone Crown for +2 Intelligence (and +2 Endurance), as its FP penalty will always be outweighed if at or below the Mind softcap of 40, or the lightweight Ruler's Mask for +1 Faith and no penalty or the heavier Imp Head (Corpse) for +2 Faith (with an effective Equip Load penalty due to weighing 3 units more).
Large enough to lower the visibility around the wearer's head slightly, which can prove a problem.

items.name: Dane's Hat
items.summary: Dane's Hat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The sun-faded and lightly soiled hat of Dryleaf Dane. Worn low over the eyes, it obscures the wearer's vision.

Meeting the gaze of another can overcome the senses, often leading to the downfall of those who would walk the noble and solitary seekers' path.

details: Automatically acquired from defeating Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel near the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace.

→ To challenge Dane, the player must first acquire the May the Best Win gesture, from near the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, then perform the gesture (without canceling it with a roll) in front of Dane.

notes: This item is part of Dane's Set.

items.name: Radiant Gold Mask
items.summary: Radiant Gold Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism.

Strengthens Golden Order incantations.

Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit.

"To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

details: Can be found on a corpse at the edge of the north part of the broken bridge in Altus Plateau.

notes: Passively boosts Golden Order Incantations by 10%.

items.name: Perfumer Hood
items.summary: Perfumer Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times of past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

details: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

items.name: Traveler's Hat
items.summary: Traveler's Hat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf
items.summary: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Headscarf worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to
alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction
is what earned them their name.

details: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

items.name: Ruler's Mask
items.summary: Ruler's Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask in the image of a wizened sage. Customary dress among lords in smaller nation. Increases faith.

Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality. One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

details: Found on a corpse on a broken caravan near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.

notes: Increases Faith by 1 point.

items.name: Consort's Mask
items.summary: Consort's Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the
image of a foreign queen. Increases dexterity.

Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working
as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort.
She was the only human to remain by his side when he became
the serpent of blasphemy.

In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

details: Dropped upon ending Tanith's questline.

notes: Increases Dexterity by 1 point.

items.name: Marais Mask
items.summary: Marais Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble. Customarily
worn by the head of House Marais. Increases arcane.

The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving
as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This
mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

details: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.

notes: Increases Arcane by 1 point.

items.name: Great Horned Headband
items.summary: Great Horned Headband is a headgear armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Headband decorated by a pair of great horns. Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

details: Great Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

items.name: Shining Horned Headband
items.summary: Shining Horned Headband is a headgear armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

Horns with buds that also shine are ideal ceremonial items for ancestral worship. Strengthens Ancestral Infant's Head.

details: Shining Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

notes: Increased the damage of the Ancestral Infant's Head by 20%.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Hood
items.summary: Godskin Apostle Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders
of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh,
the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

details: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

items.name: Godskin Noble Hood
items.summary: Godskin Noble Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

details: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
items.summary: Sanguine Noble Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

details: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees north west of Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Wise Man's Mask
items.summary: Wise Man's Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The iron mask of Sir Ansbach, giving the appearance of a quiet, wise, old bearded man.

But an old fear lurks beneath, together with the cold, unflinching discipline that once honed his blade, now employed to enhance Blood Oath and dynastic skills.
effect_details: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by +5%

details: Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

notes: This item is part of Ansbach's Set.

infobox.effects: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills

items.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
items.summary: Crimson Tear Scarab is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Red scarab worn directly on the head. The red scarabs roll clumps of crimson tears during their labors.

Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but increases damage taken.
effect_details: The Crimson Tear Scarab boosts the HP restoration of the Flask of Crimson Tears by 10%, but reduces all damage negations by 10%.

details: Found after the Temple of Eiglay. To reach it, jump off the bridge where you first meet a Man-Serpent. It can be seen on a corpse on a ledge.

items.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
items.summary: Cerulean Tear Scarab is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Blue scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Cerulean Tears, but increases damage taken.
effect_details: The Cerulean Tear Scarab boosts the FP restoration of the Flask of Cerulean Tears by 10%, but reduces all damage negations by 10%.

details: Found in the northeastern section of the town, on a corpse on the rooftops.

items.name: Ash-of-War Scarab
items.summary: The Ash-of-War Scarab is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gray scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of Ashes of War during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP cost of skills, but increases damage taken.
effect_details: The Ash-of-War Scarab reduces the FP cost of skills by 15%, but lowers all damage negations by 10%.

details: Found on a corpse on the edge of the broken bridge right behind a portal.

infobox.effects:
*Reduces FP cost of Ashes of War
*Decreases defense

items.name: Glintstone Scarab
items.summary: The Glintstone Scarab is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP costs of sorceries, but increases damage taken.
effect_details: The Glintstone Scarab reduces the FP cost of sorcery spells by 15%, but lowers all damage negations by 10%.

details: The Glintstone Scarab is found inside a chest near the Glintstone Sorcerers who summon the giant rolling ball after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Incantation Scarab
items.summary: The Incantation Scarab is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Golden scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken.

As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for the long journey to its home nest.
effect_details: The Incantation Scarab reduces the FP cost of incantation spells by 15%, but lowers all damage negations by 10%.

details: Obtain the "Homing Instinct" Painting from the Artist's Shack in Limgrave.
Interact with the spirit of the painter southwest of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins, located beside a gravestone.

items.name: Imp Head (Cat)
items.summary: The Imp Head (Cat) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a cat, it holds trace amounts of feline intelligence.
effect_details: Raises Intelligence by +2.

details: Has a base 0.5% chance to drop from Cat-headed Imps found all throughout various catacombs, including the Stormfoot Catacombs to the northwest of the Church of Elleh.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Imp Head (Wolf)
items.summary: Imp Head (Wolf) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a wolf, it holds trace amounts of lupine endurance.
effect_details: Raises Endurance by +2.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs. Dropped by Imp enemies with the same face.
Has a base 1.5% chance to drop from Wolf-headed Imps found inside various catacombs, such as the Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Imp Head (Fanged)
items.summary: The Imp Head (Fanged) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a fanged demon, it holds trace amounts of bestial
strength.
effect_details: Raises Strength by +2.

details: Has a base 0.5% chance to drop from Fanged-headed Imps found all throughout various catacombs, such as the ones inside the Cliffbottom Catacombs located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Imp Head (Long-Tongued)
items.summary: The Imp Head (Long-Tongued) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a long-tongued demon, it holds trace amounts of
vexatious dexterity.
effect_details: Raises Dexterity by +2.

details: Has a base 0.5% chance to drop from Long-tongued-headed Imps found inside the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Imp Head (Corpse)
items.summary: The Imp Head (Corpse) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling the visage of a corpse, it holds trace amounts of
lingering faith.
effect_details: Raises Faith by +2.

details: Found on a corpse on the streets of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can be accessed by going south from the giant door leading to the area where the Grand Lift of Rold is located.
→ WARNING: If Maliketh is defeated before this item is acquired it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Imp Head (Elder)
items.summary: The Imp Head (Elder) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling an elder, it holds trace amounts of arcane knowledge.
effect_details: Raises Arcane by +2.

details: Found on a corpse in front of an Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemy inside the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Imp Head (Lion)
items.japanese_name: インプの頭（獅子 Inpu no Atama (Shishi)
items.summary: The Imp Head (Lion) is an armor piece found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling a lion in appearance, life force faintly clings to it.
effect_details: Raises Vigor by +2.

details: Found on a somewhat hidden ledge in the catacombs.

→ Once having reached the great hall with the arching bridge and the two giant falling spike traps. Get passed the first set of falling spikes and climb the ladder by the second spike trap. This item can be found on top of the wall immediately in front of the ladder.

→ To get on top of this wall, walk up to the corner where the wall meets the guard-rail to trigger the spike trap to fall, then jump on top of the trap after its finished descending. The trap will then ascend up to the ledge where this item can be acquired.

notes: The Imp Head (Lion) armor has 3 more Poise than all the other Imp Head items; Imp Head (Lion) has 13 poise while the other Imp Heads have 10.
Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Nox Mirrorhelm
items.summary: Nox Mirrorhelm is a helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass. One among the Eternal City's ritual implements. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

Worn by those committed to high treason, it wards off the intervention of the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers.

details: The Nox Mirrorhelm is located at the Cliffbottom Catacombs in southeast Liurnia. It is found on body placed behind a stonesword key imp statue that is unlocked with one Stonesword Key.

items.name: Iji's Mirrorhelm
items.summary: Iji's Mirrorhelm is a helm armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass, said to have never left War Counselor Iji's head. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

Worn by those committed to high treason, it wards off the intervention of the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers.

Iji was afraid. Terrified of his own treachery.

details: Can be looted from War Counselor Iji after completing Blaidd's questline.

items.name: Silver Tear Mask
items.summary: Silver Tear Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk.

Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power.

To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.
effect_details: Increases Arcane by +8 at the cost of reducing Physical Attack Power by -5%.

details: Received upon defeating the Mimic Tear boss.

notes: The Silver Tear Mask does not belong to any armor set.

items.name: Envoy Crown
items.summary: Envoy Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys. Densely
wrapped in several layers of cloth.

Raises the potency of bubble-based skills.

No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have
heard a faint whimpering from inside. It must have been their
imagination.

details: Found on a corpse behind a Giant Oracle Envoy enemy near the Haligtree Canopy site of grace in Miquella's Haligtree.

notes: Increases the damage of Oracular Bubble, Great Oracular Bubble, and Bubble Shower by 15%.

items.name: Octopus Head
items.summary: Octopus Head is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A land octopus whelp worn directly on the head. Has a lingering warmth reminiscent of human skin.

Those who can withstand the smell will find its organic elasticity excellent for negating strikes.

details: Chance to drop from Land Octopus enemies.

items.name: Jar
items.summary: Jar is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Jar that fits cleanly over the head when upturned. Made with
pride by Iron Fist Alexander.

In a uniquely jarlike gesture of friendship, it boosts the power of
throwing pot items.
effect_details: Increases the damage of Throwing Pots made with cracked pots and ritual pots by +15%.

details: Follow Iron Fist Alexander's questline until you see him on Mt. Gelmir. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue, and he will grant you the Jar.

notes: Very famously worn by Let Me Solo Her.
The Jarwight Puppet wears this helm.

items.name: Greatjar
items.summary: Greatjar is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A greatjar which fits comfortably over the head when upturned. Attire of the shamans who perform their worship at gaols.

Increases the power of thrown pots of all sizes.

They offer their prayers to the innards of the greatjars, such that they might be reborn one day into sainthood. This is the cycle of death and rebirth, taken into the hands of mortal men.
effect_details: Increases the damage of Throwing Pots made with cracked pots, ritual pots and hefty pots by +17%.

details: Found by the Greatjar altar towards the end of the dungeon.

→ Once arrived at the final open area, past the maze of jars. There will be an idle jar-elevator to the right side of the bottomless fissure. Jumping down, on top of this hanging jar will make it begin to ascend. Taking this jar elevator all the way to the top will leave the player next to the path that'll eventually lead to the gratjar altar, along with this item.

notes: Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

infobox.effects: Raises potency of throwing pots of all sizes

items.name: Albinauric Mask
items.summary: Albinauric Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask made from the largely unaltered hide of a young Albinauric.

Raises arcane, but reduces the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears.

A far cry from godskin, this Albinauric hide mask is the product of malicious mockery.

details: Found alongside the Albinauric Staff on a corpse near an Omenkiller in the same building as the Guest Hall grace in Volcano Manor. It is accessed by jumping on a balcony with a visible opened door.

notes: Increases Arcane by 4 points, but reduces the HP restoration of the Flask of Crimson Tears by 10%

items.name: Black Wolf Mask
items.summary: Black Wolf Mask is an helm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A mask fashioned after the head of a black wolf.

Relic of an assassin who assumed the guise of Ranni the Witch's loyal shadow. The likeness is striking.

details: The Black Wolf Mask is found on a corpse upon the broken walls near Seluvis's Rise at Three Sisters, located in west Liurnia.

items.name: Blue Cloth Cowl
items.summary:
Blue Cloth Cowl is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Blue Cloth Set.
items.description:
Cowl of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer.

Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.

details: Starting gear for the Warrior class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

items.name: Crimson Hood
items.summary: Crimson Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A hooded cloak of vivid crimson. Worn by expatriated royalty.
Increases vigor.

Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on journeys
without specific orders, to faraway lands from which they
would never return. In other words, the gift of a cloak made
it easier for undesirables to be on their way.

Roderika never once saw the guidance of grace.
effect_details: The Crimson Hood increases the wearer's Vigor by +1.

details: Found on top of a corpse pile inside Stormveil Castle after completing Roderika's questline. It's on the same corpse pile that the Chrysalids' Memento was initially found on.

notes: The Crimson Hood is part of the Noble's Traveling Set.

items.name: Navy Hood
items.summary: Navy Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A hooded cloak of deep navy. Worn by expatriated royalty. Increases mind.

Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on missions to faraway lands, from which they would never return. But what choice did they have, having seen the guidance of grace?
effect_details: The Navy Hood increases the wearer's Mind by +1.

details: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture.

notes: The Navy Hood is part of the Noble's Traveling Set.

items.name: White Mask
items.summary: White Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bloodstained, faintly grinning mask.

Worn by war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.

The Lord of Blood's curse enlivens the wearer when bloodletting occurs. Slightly raises attack power when there is blood loss nearby.
effect_details: Increases the player's Attack Power by +10% (+6% in PvP) when blood loss occurs nearby, including the wearer themself.

details: Dropped by killing one of the three Nameless White Mask NPC invaders in the Mohgwyn Palace, northwest of the Palace Approach Ledge-Road Site of Grace, in the blood-filled lake. The White Mask that drops the Surgeon's set is found near the large stone pillar at the south of the swamp, directly west of the Site of Grace.

notes: Stacks with the Lord of Blood's Exultation.
This is part of the War Surgeon Set.

items.name: Thiollier's Mask
items.summary: Thiollier's Mask is an armor piece found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A mask upon which is carved a tranquil sleeping face.

The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane.

Just once, Thiollier was granted the sweet repose of velvety sleep. The remainder of his days would be spent attempting to recapture it.
effect_details: Raises Arcane by +3.

details: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

notes: This item is part of Thiollier's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Chapeau
items.summary: Nomadic Merchant's Chapeau is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Chapeau of the nomadic merchants. Decorated with tiny gems in a wide spectrum of colors.

These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground.

Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

details: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

items.name: Bandit Mask
items.summary: Bandit Mask is an armor piece in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask of black cloth that covers the mouth.

Favored by bandits for hiding their faces, it also provides some protection against poison.

details: Starting gear for the Bandit class.
Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in northern Limgrave for 1,500 Runes.

notes: The Bandit Mask is part of the Bandit Set.

items.name: Black Hood
items.summary: Black Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood of lusterless black fabric that conceals its wearer's identity.

In this world, there is very little that must necessarily be known.

details: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in Sage's Cave located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Confessor Hood
items.summary:
Confessor Hood is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Confessor Set.
items.description:
Black hood for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church
confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the
teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the
guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to
hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

details: Starting gear for the Confessor class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

items.name: Confessor Hood (Altered)
items.summary:
Confessor Hood (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Confessor Set.

It is the altered form of the Confessor Hood.
items.description:
Cloth headwrap worn under a church confessor's black hood.

Such hoods are made for blending in with the darkness.

details: Starting gear for the Confessor class. (unaltered)
Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).
Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

items.name: Omensmirk Mask
items.summary: Omensmirk Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers. Increases strength.

Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight.

This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.
effect_details: Increases Strength by 2.

details: Guaranteed drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital
→ Dropped by an Omenkiller enemy right outside the Lower Capital Church Site of Grace.

items.name: Skeletal Mask
items.summary: Skeletal Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face. Worn by the assassins of Ravenmount.

This ritual implement relentlessly digs into the wearer's face, preserving one's human instincts while dressed in imitation of the Deathbirds.

details: Found inside a chest in Sage's Cave located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Gravebird Helm
items.summary: Gravebird Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Stone helm with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Empowers spells which summon rings of spectral light.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.
effect_details: Increases the Attack Power of the Rings of Spectral Light Sorcery by +15%.

details: Can be found on top of a stone altar in one of the floors above the Spiral Rise site of grace.

→ To reach this item, get passed the section with the Gravebirds, then past the rooftops with the snowstorm-conjuring Divine Beast Warrior, until re-entering the spiral rise to witness an Inquisitor taking an elevator up.
→→ The player can then reach the item by either taking the spiral staircase down, then jump off of the lowest point of the stairs to land on top of the altar.
→→ Or the player can go up to the next floor, take the elevator down, then jump off the elevator in the middle of its descent to land on top of the altar.

notes: This item is part of the Gravebird Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Dancer's Hood
items.summary: Dancer's Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bright-red hood of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on.

To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.
effect_details: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by +2.5%.

details: Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Dancer's Set.

items.name: Foot Soldier Helm
items.summary: Foot Soldier Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Wholly unembellished iron helm. Widely issued to foot
soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Foot Soldier Helmet
items.summary: Foot Soldier Helmet is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helmet with a protective metal plate. Widely issued to foot
soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Foot Soldier Cap
items.summary: Foot Soldier Cap is a piece of headgear armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

items.name: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap
items.summary: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Flanged cap made from gilded iron. Issued to foot soldiers
protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Sacred Crown Helm
items.summary: Sacred Crown Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith.

Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

Who is that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?
effect_details: Increases Faith by 1.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Highwayman Hood
items.summary: Highwayman Hood is a piece of headgear armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hideously stained and ragged hood. Worn by former foot
soldiers who have turned to banditry.

details: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

items.name: Common Soldier Helm
items.summary: Common Soldier Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

acquisition.location: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Common Soldier Set.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Helm
items.summary: Vulgar Militia Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.

details: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Helm
items.summary: Shadow Militiaman Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

notes: This item is part of the Shadow Militiaman Set.

items.name: Duelist Helm
items.summary: Duelist Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by
gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer
becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience
delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

details: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, as they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

notes: Increases the wearer's target priority, making enemies far more likely to target the wearer at further distances.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
items.summary: Rotten Duelist Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot.

Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

details: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.

notes: Increases the wearer's target priority, making enemies far more likely to target the wearer at further distances.

items.name: Nox Monk Hood
items.summary: Nox Monk Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silk hood worn by monks of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Nox Monk enemies.

items.name: Nox Monk Hood (Altered)
items.summary: Nox Monk Hood (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood worn by monks of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Monk enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Crown
items.summary: Nox Swordstress Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Crown worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and the silk hides their eyes.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Nox Swordstress enemies.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Crown (Altered)
items.summary: Nox Swordstress Crown (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Crown worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. The silk eye covering is removed, flaunting convention.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Swordstress enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Night Maiden Twin Crown
items.summary: Night Maiden Twin Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Twin crowns worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and hides the eyes with silk.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Night Maiden enemies.

items.name: Champion Headband
items.summary:
Champion Headband is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Champion Set
items.description:
Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the
wearer has slaughtered countless foes.

Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave
warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

details: Starting gear for the Hero class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

notes: This was originally the starting headgear for the Champion class in the Closed Network Test with slightly different stats.

items.name: Leather Headband
items.summary: Leather Headband is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Headband worn by highland warriors, made of woven leather. The white favor represents their home settlement.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

details: Acquired from a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, found in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

notes: This item is part of the Highland Warrior Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Leather Crown
items.summary: Leather Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm worn by highland warriors, pieced together using leather. The white favor represents their home settlement.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

details: Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear.

notes: This item is part of the Highland Warrior Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Fang Helm
items.summary: Fang Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. The cheek guards are shaped after lion fangs.

Perhaps his fascination with the untamed strength of the wild stemmed from his past as a Redmane.

details: Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Iron Rivet Set.

items.name: Igon's Helm
items.summary: Igon's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. This tattered protective-wear is shaped like a bugle.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

details: Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline.

→ Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.)
→ This will make Igon appear just past the arena, exhaust his dialogue there until he gives Igon's Furled Finger.
→ Defeat Bayle the Dread at the top of the Jagged Peak (summoning Igon for the fight is optional).
→ After Bayle has been felled, return to the location where Igon gave his furled finger. As this item, along with several others, can now be recovered from his body.

notes: This item is part of Igon's Set.
Can be altered into Igon's Helm (Altered).
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Igon's Helm (Altered)
items.summary: Igon's Helm (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

details: Acquired from altering Igon's Helm.
→ Which can be acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline.

→→ Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.)
→→ This will make Igon appear just past the arena, exhaust his dialogue there until he gives Igon's Furled Finger.
→→ Defeat Bayle the Dread at the top of the Jagged Peak (summoning Igon for the fight is optional).
→→ After Bayle has been felled, return to the location where Igon gave his furled finger. As this item, along with several others, can now be recovered from his body.

notes: This item is part of Igon's Set.
Can be altered into Igon's Helm.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Curseblade Mask
items.summary: Curseblade Mask is an armor piece in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity.

Divine invocation heightens the dexterity of the wearer, but causes the blessings of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effects of drinking from the flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this mask.
effect_details: Raises dexterity by +5.
Reduces potency of sacred flasks by -7%.
Reduces focus by -30.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

notes: This item is part of the Ascetic's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

infobox.effects:
*Raises dexterity
*Reduces focus
*Reduces potency of sacred flasks

items.name: Pelt of Ralva
items.summary: Pelt of Ralva is an armor piece found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The pelt of Ralva the Great Red Bear, worn upon the head without modification.

Enhances incantations of what is jokingly called "Bear Communion."

This untreated hide, won at the end of a bloody bout, is just the thing to make a wild bear out of a warrior.
effect_details: Boosts the Attack Power of Roar of Rugalea by +15%.

details: Dropped from Ralva the Great Red Bear whom can be found by a pond in a forest, located northeast of the Highroad Cross site of grace.

notes: This headpiece is an individual piece of armor and does not belong to any another armor set. However, the Pelt of Ralva is associated with the Iron Rivet Set.

infobox.effects: *Increases the power of Roar of Rugalea.

items.name: Chain Coif
items.summary: Chain Coif is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

details: Sold by Kalé

items.name: Iron Helmet
items.summary: Iron Helmet is a piece of headgear armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An iron helmet showing rust on its edges.

Cloth covering the mouth and neck provides some resistance
to poison and other irritants.

details: Sold by Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Helm
items.summary:
Godrick Soldier Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Soldier Set.
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Made from
durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Helm
items.summary: Raya Lucarian Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Soldier enemies.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Helm
