items.summary: Radahn Soldier Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

details: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Helm
items.summary: Leyndell Soldier Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif
beneath.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Helm
items.summary: Haligtree Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. An iron helm
graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

notes: Increases Faith by 1 point.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Helm
items.summary: Messmer Soldier Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The iron helm features a visor.

Though the engraving upon the forehead is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Messmer Soldier Set.

items.name: Exile Hood
items.summary: Exile Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Deep red hood that covers the whole head.

Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were
required to keep their faces hidden.

details: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

items.name: Kaiden Helm
items.summary: Kaiden Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the
mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on
horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

details: Chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

items.name: Land of Reeds Helm
items.summary:
Land of Reeds Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Land of Reeds Set.
items.description:
Helm made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by
warriors of the Land of Reeds.

The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war,
during which time it has remained alienated from the
cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation
has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

details: Starting gear for Samurai origin.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

items.name: Okina Mask
items.summary: Okina Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A wooden mask that depicts an old man baring his teeth. The source of the sobriquet of the great swordsman of the Land of the Reeds. Raises dexterity as it lowers focus.

The more he sharpened his mind, the more the absurdities of the world came into stark relief. And so Okina renounced it all, and rose to a higher plane. There was only himself. His katana. And its mastery.

Before long, Okina became a demon of a swordsman.
effect_details: Raises the user's Dexterity by +2, but lowers their Focus by -50.

details: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants
Received upon defeating the NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina near the Church of Repose.

notes: This item is part of the White Reed Set.
Okina means "old man" in Japanese.

items.name: Iron Kasa
items.summary: Iron Kasa is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Iron kasa of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Crafted to
imitate the woven straw hats worn in the Land of Reeds.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest
reaches of his heart.

details: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

items.name: Eccentric's Hood
items.summary: Eccentric's Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A pointy, ragged hood. Worn by the knight Jerren.

The hood hides an aged, bearded mask.

Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they
are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

details: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

items.name: Eccentric's Hood (Altered)
items.summary: Eccentric's Hood (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. It is the altered form of the Eccentric's Hood
items.description:
A pointy, ragged hood. Worn by the knight Jerren.

The hood hides an aged, bearded mask.

Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they
are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

details: Received (unaltered) after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

items.name: Freyja's Helm
items.summary: Freyja's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden helm of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

A hideous scarlet wound was once hewn into the center of her face.

Later, Miquella gently put his lips to it and the unfading scar became the compass that Freyja would thereafter follow.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Redmane Freyja at either of the following locations:
details: Specimen Storehouse - If the player chooses to kill her by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, as it is the first location where she's vulnerable to being attacked.

→ Freyja can also simply be completely ignored, then this item will be left behind where she once was, once the player has engaged with the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight at least once. With no need to engage with her in combat.

→→ Note that Freyja dying or disappearing before the player has recieved the Golden Lion Shield from her, makes that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough (outside of having it be left by another player during online play). The player can however simply refrain from killing Freyja until after they've received the shield.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to give Freyja the Letter for Freyja key item at the Specimen Storehouse, without immediately killing her afterwards.
→ Freyja will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on her corpse, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

notes: This item is part of Freyja's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Helm
items.summary: Marionette Soldier Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice. Worn
by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this helm is remarkably crude.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

details: Chance to drop from Marionette Soldier enemies.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm
items.summary: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Metal helm formed in the likeness of the face of a bird. Worn by
avionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this helm is remarkably crude.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

details: Chance to drop from Avionette Soldier enemies.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Hood
items.summary: Blue Silver Mail Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

details: Chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies.

items.name: Fire Monk Hood
items.summary: Fire Monk Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with
flames. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden
by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of
the Giants.

details: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Hood
items.summary: Blackflame Monk Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

details: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

items.name: Zamor Mask
items.summary: Zamor Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mask worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants.

These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

details: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Black Knife Hood
items.summary: Black Knife Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

details: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Helm of Night
items.summary: Helm of Night is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bottomless black helm, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

details: Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol.

→ To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own. This elevator will first descend down to a stone bridge (which when followed, will progress towards the end of the dungeon) before automatically ascending back up again. Jumping back onto the jar-elevator as it ascends and staying on it until it reaches the top will eventually take the player to the section where this item can be found.

notes: This item is part of the Night Set.

items.name: Malenia's Winged Helm
items.summary: Malenia's Winged Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Winged helm made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia,
Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the
allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

items.name: Elden Lord Crown
items.summary: Elden Lord Crown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Crown of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey
was lord of the battlefield.

He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone.
And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell.
And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's
eyes faded.

details: Sold by Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

items.name: Messmer's Helm
items.summary: Messmer's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills.

The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.

They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.
effect_details: Enhances Messmer's Flame Incantations by +3%.
Enhances Fire Knight Skills by +8%.

details: Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

notes: This item is part of Messmer's Set.
Can be altered into Messmer's Helm (Altered).

infobox.effects: Slightly enhances Messmer's flame incantations and Fire Knight skills

items.name: Messmer's Helm (Altered)
items.summary: Messmer's Helm (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's fire as well as Fire Knight skills.

The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.

They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.
effect_details: Enhances Messmer's Flame Incantations by +3%.
Enhances Fire Knight Skills by +8%.

details: Acquired from altering Messmer's Helm.
→ Which can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

notes: This item is part of Messmer's Set.
Can be altered into Messmer's Helm.

items.name: Knight Helm
items.summary:
Knight Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Knight Set.
items.description:
Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage
negation.

details: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Helm
items.summary:
Vagabond Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Vagabond Knight Set.
items.description:
Helm of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and
battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

The visor is broken and can no longer be lowered.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant
damage negation.

details: Starting gear for the Vagabond class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

items.name: Greathelm
items.summary: Greathelm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Sturdy greathelm made from iron.

Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the
wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.

details: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

items.name: Carian Knight Helm
items.summary: Carian Knight Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian
royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all
heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the
decline of the royal family.

details: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Godrick Knight Helm
items.summary: The Godrick Knight Helm is a piece of headgear and a part of the Godrick Knight Set in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Adorned
with a plume of withered, ashen hair.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Helm
items.summary: Cuckoo Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is
adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

details: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

items.name: Redmane Knight Helm
items.summary: Redmane Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

The red plume is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son - the mane of the proud Red Lion.

details: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Helm
items.summary: Gelmir Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Its crest of red
feathers symbolizes Rykard's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son.

details: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Helm
items.summary:
Leyndell Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Leyndell Knight Set.
items.description:
Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell.

The golden canopy represents the honor of standing among the
tree's defenders.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
items.summary: Haligtree Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown
of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

details: Found on a corpse up a ladder near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

notes: Increases Faith by 2 points.

items.name: Black Knight Helm
items.summary: Black Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

notes: This item is part of the Black Knight Set.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Helm
items.summary: Bloodhound Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Metal helm with a pointed beak. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

details: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight Set.

items.name: Cleanrot Helm
items.summary:
Cleanrot Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of the Cleanrot Set.
items.description:
Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their
undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite
the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their
acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

details: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

items.name: Cleanrot Helm (Altered)
items.summary:
Cleanrot Helm (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. It is the altered form of the Cleanrot Helm.

It's part of the Cleanrot Set.
items.description:
Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their
undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite
the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their
acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Cleanrot Knight enemies. It can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Fire Knight Helm
items.summary: Fire Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Slightly increases maximum HP, stamina, and maximum equip load.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.
effect_details: Increases HP by +2%.
Increases Stamina by +5%.
Increases max Equip Load by +4.5%.

details: 3% chance of dropping from Fire Knights.

notes: This item is part of the Fire Knight Set.

items.name: Winged Serpent Helm
items.summary: Winged Serpent Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. A winged serpent perches atop it.

Enhances Fire Knight skills.

The winged serpent is the token creature of Messmer's military forces. It is a wise friend which keeps the base serpent at bay and holds its power in check.
effect_details: Increases the Attack Power of Fire Knight skills by +10%.
→ The eligible skills are: Flame Skewer, Flame Spear, Flare, O Serpent, and Messmer's Assault.

details: Drops from Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights, who can be found patrolling the entrance to the tower housing Messmer's Dark Chamber.

notes: This headpiece is an individual piece of armor and does not belong to any another armor set. However, the Winged Serpent Helm is associated with the Fire Knight Set.

items.name: Death Mask Helm
items.summary: Death Mask Helm is an armor piece found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of Wego, elder among the Fire Knights. Two warped death masks stacked one atop the other.

Reduces FP used to summon spirits.

Gnawed at by loneliness, the old man turned his attention to the spirituality of Messmer's flame, using it in a rite of resurrection.

Yet the soulless bodies he brought to life were no comfort to poor Wego.
effect_details: Decreases the cost of summoning spirits by -15%.

details: Drops from Wego, Fire Knight Elder, who can be found in the middle of the central church, summoning Putrid Corpses.

notes: This headpiece is an individual piece of armor and does not belong to any another armor set. However, the Death Mask Helm is associated with the Fire Knight Set.

infobox.effects: *Decreases the FP cost of summoning Spirit Ashes

items.name: Salza's Hood
items.summary: Salza's Hood is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Hood of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights.

A prodigious amount of cloth wound around it, giving the impression of a greatly swollen head, and wearing it increases intelligence.

A disciple of the elder Wego, he refused to burn down an old ruin, at the risk of his own life.
effect_details: Raises Intelligence by +2.

details: Drops from Salza, Sage of the Fire Knights, who can be found at the very end of bridge by the Western Rampart of the Shadow Keep, guarding the entrance to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

notes: This headpiece is an individual piece of armor and does not belong to any another armor set. However, Salza's Hood is associated with the Fire Knight Set.

items.name: Death Knight Helm
items.summary: Death Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden helm of the Death Knights, whose own death masks served as the visards of their armor.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

The decayed golden wheel that adorns it represents their unbroken loyalty to Godwyn, he who became Prince of Death.
effect_details: Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Incantations by +2%.
Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Skills by +2%.

details: Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer.
→ The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

→ Once at the bottom of the elevator, there will be large open room with a staired balcony on the eastern walls. Follow this balcony while keeping an eye on the guard rail, past the lionheaded imp until the path turns to the right. There will be an opening in the in the corner of the rail. This opening will lead to a drop down to a small ledge that'll immediately lead this hidden room.

notes: This item is part of the Death Knight Set.

items.name: Horned Warrior Helm
items.summary: Horned Warrior Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm featuring a crown of sturdy tangled horns, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Attire of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

Divine invocation bolsters the strength of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.
effect_details: Raises strength by +5.
Reduces potency of Sacred Flasks by -7%.
Reduces focus by -30.

acquisition.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Horned Warrior Set.

infobox.effects:
*Raises strength
*Reduces the potency of sacred flasks
*Reduces focus

items.name: Divine Beast Helm
items.summary: Divine Beast Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine beast mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine beast warriors; the chosen of the horned warriors.

Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.
effect_details: Boosts the power of storm attacks by +4%.
Raises strength by +3.
Raises dexterity by +3.
Reduces potency of Sacred Flasks by -9%.
Reduces focus by -45.

details: 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Beast Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Divine Beast Warrior Set.

infobox.effects:
*Boosts storm attacks
*Raises strength
*Raises dexterity
*Reduces the potency of sacred flasks
*Reduces focus

items.name: Divine Bird Helm
items.summary: Divine Bird Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine bird mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine bird warriors; the very first of all horned warriors.

Divine invocation heightens the power of divine bird feathers alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.
effect_details: Enhances the power of the Divine Bird Feathers incantation by +10%.
Raises strength by +3.
Raises dexterity by +4.
Reduces potency of Sacred Flasks by -9%.
Reduces focus by -45.

details: 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Divine Bird Warrior Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

infobox.effects:
*Boosts the Divine Bird Feathers incantation
*Raises strength
*Raises dexterity
*Reduces the potency of sacred flasks
*Reduces focus

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Helm
items.summary: Oathseeker Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
An Oathseeker Knight helm. Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

details: Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

notes: This item is part of the Oathseeker Knight Set and Leda's Set.

items.name: Raging Wolf Helm
items.summary:
Raging Wolf Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Raging Wolf Set.
items.description:
A helm worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

Vargram earned his nickname from the white wolf pelt that adorns this helm.

details: Obtained as part of Bernahl's Volcano Manor quest. You will have to defeat two NPCs in a scripted invasion together with Bernahl in the Fortified Manor, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: This item was originally called "Bloody Wolf Helm" in the Closed Network Test and was part of the set worn by the test-only class, Bloody Wolf.

items.name: Hoslow's Helm
items.summary: Hoslow's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments.
Symbol of the head of the revered House of Hoslow.

Juno Hoslow had a younger brother who was all talk and no
trousers.

His inability to commit to action was such that Juno inherited the
Hoslow legacy without resistance, granting him the freedom to
shower his little brother with adoration.

details: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

items.name: Diallos's Mask
items.summary: Diallos's Mask is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments.
Only, without the twin tails.

Diallos Hoslow had an older brother who was a stern,
self-possessed man of few words. His achievements made
him seem out of reach.

And so the younger aspired to be like the older. Yearning
for the day that he would tell the tale of House Hoslow, in blood.
Knowing full well that it would break his brother's heart.

details: Obtained from Knight Diallos after completing his questline, or by killing him.

items.name: Twinned Helm
items.summary: Twinned Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

details: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

items.name: Drake Knight Helm
items.summary: Drake Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron helm worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of
a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter
and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend
their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime
beauty and inspiration of awe.

details: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

items.name: Drake Knight Helm (Altered)
items.summary: Drake Knight Helm (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. It is the altered form of the Drake Knight Helm.
items.description:
Black iron helm worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of
a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter
and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend
their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime
beauty and inspiration of awe.

details: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

items.name: Briar Helm
items.summary:
Briar Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Briar Set.
items.description:
Battered iron helm from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar at Shaded Castle.

notes: Deals 18 Standard physical damage if colliding with an enemy when rolling.

items.name: Fingerprint Helm
items.summary:
Fingerprint Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fingerprint Set.
items.description:
Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke,
knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord
than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below
the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force
lure him with suggestion?

details: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Rakshasa Helm
items.summary: Rakshasa Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.
effect_details: Increases attack power +2%.
Reduces damage negation by -2%.

details: Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Rakshasa Set.

items.name: Royal Remains Helm
items.summary: Royal Remains Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly resplenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

details: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

notes: Restores 2 HP per second when the wearer is at below 18% of their maximum health. The restoration effects stop once their health raises past the threshold.

items.name: All-Knowing Helm
items.summary: All-Knowing Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

details: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon defeat.

items.name: Royal Knight Helm
items.summary: Royal Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver helm of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

items.name: Rellana's Helm
items.summary: Rellana's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

Rennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair.

details: Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

notes: This item is part of Rellana's Set.

items.name: Maliketh's Helm
items.summary: Maliketh's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Beast's helm made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn
by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued
with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not
fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made
them champions.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Banished Knight Helm
items.summary: Banished Knight Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Perhaps the deep-red scarf was used to block the winds, for on the outskirts, the winds bite with a stinging fierceness.

details: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.

notes: The Japanese name of these knights is 失地騎士 (shicchi kishi); knights who have lost their land to an enemy. The implication is they are "Banished Knights" because they have been driven from their homeland by force.

items.name: Banished Knight Helm (Altered)
items.summary: Banished Knight Helm (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. It is the altered form of Banished Knight Helm.
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

details: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it. Cannot be obtained by altering it yourself.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Helm
items.summary: Night's Cavalry Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Pitch-black helm with flowing black hair. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

details: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Helm (Altered)
items.summary: Night's Cavalry Helm (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Pitch-black helm thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

details: Received unaltered upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Helm of Solitude
items.summary: Helm of Solitude is an armor piece in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Steel helm of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

details: Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Solitude Set.

items.name: Veteran's Helm
items.summary: Veteran's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An old helm that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

details: Sold by Finger Reader Enia after Commander Niall has been defeated.

items.name: Scaled Helm
items.summary: Scaled Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

details: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Beast Champion Helm
items.summary: Beast Champion Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

The beasts, their eyes and ears covered, represent an oath: "See nothing, hear nothing, doubt nothing, and carry on, along the path set in stone.

details: Received upon:
Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Helm
items.summary: Tree Sentinel Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Very few are permitred to wear a golden wood crest of such size as seen on this helm.

details: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Helm
items.summary: Malformed Dragon Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A malformed golden helm. Adorned with various dragon
imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels
had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was
to become dragons themselves.

details: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Crucible Axe Helm
items.summary: Crucible Axe Helm is a helm in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

details: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.

notes: Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Crucible Tree Helm
items.summary: Crucible Tree Helm is a helm in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

details: The Crucible Tree Helm is found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths.

notes: Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Crucible Hammer-Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Devonia, the longest-serving of the Crucible Knights.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

It is said that Devonia quested in search of the Crucible's origin and departed from the lands of the Erdtree alone.

details: Obtained after defeating Crucible Knight Devonia

notes: Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

infobox.effects: Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible Incantations (4%)

items.name: Gaius's Helm
items.summary: Gaius's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The black iron helm of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.

Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

details: Can be bought for 8000 from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Commander Gaius.

notes: This item is part of Gaius's Set.

items.name: Radahn's Redmane Helm
items.summary: Radahn's Redmane Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair. Worn by General Radahn.

Radahn inherited the furious, flaming red hair of his father Radagon, and is fond of its heroic implications.

"I was born a champion's cub. Now I am the Lord of the Battlefield's lion."

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Young Lion's Helm
items.summary: Young Lion's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The golden helm worn by Radahn in his younger years. Proudly displaying his heroic red hair, it is fitting attire for a lion.

When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear—

"Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

details: Can be bought for 12000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

notes: This item is part of the Young Lion's Set.

items.name: Lionel's Helm
items.summary:
Lionel's Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Lionel's Set.
items.description:
Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim. Worn by
Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been
driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

details: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Bull-Goat Helm
items.summary: Bull-Goat Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

details: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

notes: This is part of the Bull-Goat Set.

items.name: Verdigris Helm
items.summary: Verdigris Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Helm made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:
details: Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever".

→ Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood. Here, this item can be safely recovered from his body, with no need for a fight.
Enir-Ilim - If the player selects "Put it behind you" when talking to Moore.
→ Moore will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his body, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

acquisition.location: / Scadu Altus - The player can also get this item from killing Moore when he invades as retribution for the murder of two forager brood members.
details: Note that Moore will not drop his bell bearing if killed in this manner, thus making that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough.

notes: This item is part of the Verdigris Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Omen Helm
items.summary: Omen Helm is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, its form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence? What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all.

details: Received at the end of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

notes: Increases the damage of the Omen Bairn and the Regal Omen Bairn, as well as the heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks during the effect of Shriek of Milos, by 5%.

items.name: Fire Prelate Helm
items.summary:
Fire Prelate Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fire Prelate Set.
items.description:
Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a
cauldron. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire
Monks.

It is said the cauldron perched atop the head was originally
furnished with embers, and would surge into flames when
the wearer's faith reached its zenith. The fire of this cauldron
has since died out, however.

details: Chance to drop from Fire Prelates.

items.name: Pumpkin Helm
items.summary: The Pumpkin Helm is an armor piece in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An oval helm large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard.

Reduces damage from headshots and impacts.

The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

details: Has a base 3% chance to drop from Mad Pumpkin Head enemies.

notes: The Pumpkin Helm reduces the damage taken from headshots by 30% and reduces the stun time.
The reduction applies to both ranged and melee damage.
Does not stack with the Crucible Knot Talisman.
This is the heaviest helm in the game along with the Greatjar.
The Pumpkin Helm does not belong to any armor set.

items.name: Divine Beast Head
items.summary: Divine Beast Head is an armor piece in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ritual headwear in the form of a divine beast's head, used to perform the lion dance. Worn by the very finest of the sculpted keepers. Alas, it no longer responds to the old woman's earnest prayer.

Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this headwear.
effect_details: Talking to the Hornsent Grandam while wearing this item will allow the player to gain her favor and start her questline.

Note that the Divine Beast Dancing Lion of Belurat must be dead for the grandam to respond to this item. Merely having it carry over into NG+ or having received it from another player before defeating the divine beast will not suffice.
Passive Effects:
Raises strength by +4.
Raises dexterity by +4.
Boosts the power of storm attacks by +5%.
Reduces potency of Sacred Flasks by -11%.
Reduces focus by -60.

details: Acquired from defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion at the Theatre of the Divine Beast.

infobox.effects:
*Raises strength
*Raises dexterity
*Boosts storm attacks
*Reduces the potency of sacred flasks
*Reduces focus

items.name: Cloth Garb
items.summary: Cloth Garb is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: Clothing made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

details: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

items.name: Traveler's Clothes
items.summary: Traveler's Clothes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Light yet sturdy clothes.

Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

details: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
items.summary: Commoner's Simple Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb with a modest cloth cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

details: Found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle.

notes: Increases the Faith attribute by 1 point.
The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb (altered)
items.summary: Commoner's Simple Garb (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Modest garb made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

details: Unaltered version can be found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: Increases the Faith attribute by 1 point.
The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Commoner's Garb
items.summary: Commoner's Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

details: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.
Grants +1 to Faith when worn.

items.name: Commoner's Garb (altered)
items.summary: Commoner's Garb (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb decorated with intricate embroidery. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

details: Chance to drop unaltered for Commoner enemies. Can be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.
Grants +1 to Faith when worn.

items.name: Aristocrat Garb
items.summary: Aristocrat Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

details: Chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it, such as the Sorcerer type. Two Sorcerer Wandering Nobles can be found to the east and north of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.

items.name: Aristocrat Garb (Altered)
items.summary: Aristocrat Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

details: Chance to drop from the Wandering Noble enemies that wear it.

items.name: Aristocrat Coat
items.summary: Aristocrat Coat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belongings of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

details: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two immediately north of the Mistwood Ouksirts Sites of Grace, following a torch bearer.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Gown
items.summary: Old Aristocrat Gown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

details: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

items.name: Page Garb
items.summary: Page Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

details: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Page Garb (Altered)
items.summary: Page Garb (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Page enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: High Page Clothes
items.summary: High Page Clothes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

details: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: High Page Clothes (Altered)
items.summary: High Page Clothes (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Guardian Garb
items.summary: Guardian Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

details: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it. Cannot be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Guardian Garb (Full Bloom)
items.summary: Guardian Garb (Full Bloom) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

Raises the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but greatly lowers fire damage negation.

It is said that the blood-red flowers blooming on their back mark the senescence of their ancient pact. Perhaps the guardians are part tree already.

details: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it, such as the ones in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Cannot be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: Increases the HP recovery from the Flask of Crimson Tears by 10%.

items.name: Festive Garb
items.summary: Festive Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Faintly bloodstained.

details: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be altered by yourself or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Festive Garb (Altered)
items.summary: Festive Garb (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Faintly bloodstained.

details: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be unaltered by yourself or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Blue Festive Garb
items.summary: Blue Festive Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

details: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Prisoner Clothing
items.summary:
Prisoner Clothing is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prisoner Set.
items.description:
Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling
crime.

Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.

details: Starting gear for the Prisoner class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

items.name: Braided Cord Robe
items.summary: Braided Cord Robe is is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ragged black cloth overlaid with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.

The braided cord ties together the vow of the revenger with the victims' grudges. It must never come undone.

Enhances both watchful spirits and the vengeful spirits summoned by horned bairns.
effect_details: Enhances the power of the Horned Bairn tool by +15%.
Enhances the power of the Watchful Spirit incantation by +15%.

acquisition.location: from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:
details: Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him.
→ This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.
→ Their signs will then become available to choose between at the top of the staircase found northeast of the Main Gate Plaza site of grace.
→ This option becomes inaccessible after defeating Messmer the Impaler.
Ancient Ruins of Rauh - If the player chooses to summon the Hornsent in the fight against Messmer.
→ The Hornsent will then invade the player at the top of the staircase in one of the rot-infested halls near the Church of the Bud in the southwestern quarters of Rauh.
→ Defeating him here will yield the player this item.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to defeat Messmer without the Hornsent's assistance.
→ The Hornsent will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his corpse, which can then be found in the arena after the battle is over.

notes: This item is part of the Hornsent Set.

items.name: Mushroom Body
items.summary: Mushroom Body is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the torso.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestements that root one to the earth.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Astrologer Robe
items.summary:
Astrologer Robe is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Astrologer Set.

It is the normal version of Astrologer Robe (Altered).
items.description:
Robe fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look
to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the
glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

details: Starting gear for the Astrologer class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

items.name: Astrologer Robe(Altered)
items.summary:
Astrologer Robe (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Astrologer Set.

It is the altered form of Astrologer Robe.
items.description:
Robe fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look
to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the
glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

details: Starting gear for the Astrologer class (unaltered).
Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).
Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
items.summary: Juvenile Scholar Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy.

Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

details: Requires having seen the "Resurrection" Painting inside the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes. The location depicted in the painting can be found south east of the Behind Caria Manor site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. The set will be dropped on the ground once reaching destination.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Robe
items.summary: Raya Lucarian Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.

Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep navy garb after making their vows of virtue and austerity.

But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

items.name: Lazuli Robe
items.summary: Lazuli Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy.

Theses scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

details: Chance to drop from Lazuli Sorcerer enemies that wear it.

items.name: Battlemage Robe
items.summary: Battlemage Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy scholar, tattered from being worn on the battlefied.

Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside. Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape.

details: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe
items.summary: Errant Sorcerer Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold.

A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

details: Found altered on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir. Can be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Errant Sorcerer Robe (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold.

A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Hermit Village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
items.summary: Spellblade's Traveling Attire is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

details: Complete Rogier's questline.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Increases Magic damage from Skills by 2%.

items.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
items.summary: Spellblade's Traveling Attire is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

details: Complete Rogier's questline.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Increases Magic damage from Skills by 2%.

items.name: Alberich's Robe
items.summary: Alberich's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's robe.

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthen thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

details: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: Increases the damage of Thorn Sorceries by 6%.

items.name: Alberich's Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Alberich's Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's robe.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

details: The non-altered version can be found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
items.summary: Preceptor's Long Gown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

Glintstone sorcerers are the descendant of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

details: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Preceptor's Long Gown (Altered)
items.summary: Preceptor's Long Gown (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Modest garb, previously worn under a long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it.

details: Found after finishing Ranni's questline (unaltered) inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Azur's Glintstone Robe
items.summary: Azur's Glintstone Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue-green glintstones.

Since the grand masters Azur and Lusat were driven from the academy, no one has achieved their formerly-held rank.

details: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.

items.name: Lusat's Robe
items.summary: Lusat's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue glintstones.

Since the grand masters Azur and Lusat were driven from the academy, no one has achieved their formerly-held rank.

details: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

items.name: Queen's Robe
items.summary: Queen's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

items.name: Snow Witch Robe
items.summary: Snow Witch Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Witch's robe in the color of snow.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

details: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Snow Witch Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Snow Witch Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Witch's robe in the color of snow.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

details: Found unaltered inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: High Priest Robe
items.summary:
High Priest Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.

It is part of the High Priest Set.
items.description:
Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest. Conceals the abundance of squirming beneath.

Gold embroidery decorates the purple cloth, with a jewelled ruff that sparkles like a flower wet with dew.

details: Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.
→ To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral.
→ This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.
→ Vanquishing Jolan will then get Ymir to appear by the throne to challenge the player. Defeating Ymir will then reward the player with this item, among several others.

notes: This item is part of the High Priest Set.
Can be altered into the Finger Robe.

items.name: Finger Robe
items.summary: Finger Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest. The front is open, exposing the squirming fingers beneath.

This robe is the image of his fervent desire having broken free, laying bare his greatest wish, and wearing it enhances finger sorceries.

"I will be the true mother. My fingers will grant us redemption!"
effect_details: Enhances the power of Finger Sorceries by +8%.

details: Acquired from altering the High Priest Robe, which can be obtained from defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.
→ To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral.
→ This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.
→ Vanquishing Jolan will then get Ymir to appear by the throne to challenge the player. Defeating Ymir will then reward the player with this item, among several others.

notes: This item is part of the High Priest Set.
Can be altered into the High Priest Robe.

items.name: Fia's Robe
items.summary: Fia's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe of black cloth that covers the enitre body. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk and thin enough that those embraced can feel every pulse; every bit of her warmth.

details: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D (NPC)'s twin brother.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Fia's Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Fia's Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe of black cloth that covers the enitre body. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk and thin enough that those embraced can feel every pulse; every bit of her warmth.

details: Dropped (unaltered) by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D (NPC)'s twin brother. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Deathbed Dress
items.summary: Deathbed Dress is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead.

Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer.

The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while stil sharing her warmth.
effect_details: Wearing the dress will cause the players to heal allies and Spirit Ashes within a 7 meter radius around the wearer by 2 HP every second; the wearer does not receive the passive healing.

details: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace.

→ WARNING: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, Leyndell, Royal Capital will turn to Leyndell, Ashen Capital, and the dress, along with every item in Leyndell, Royal Capital, will be unobtainable until the next New Game cycle.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug which caused the player to become more easily noticed by the enemy when wearing “Deathbed Dress”, even when crouching.
patch_notes.community_notes: The bug would cause enemies to notice a crouching player even if they are out of sight. This was presumably because the invisible effect that heals nearby allies had some sort of interaction with enemies that would grab their notice, even if no allies were nearby.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug which caused charge attack with flail to damage ally character when wearing “Deathbed Dress”
patch_notes.community_notes: Charged heavy attacks and charged horseback attacks would cause a single-digit amount of damage to the wearere of the dress, Torrent, and any other nearby allies when the attack is being charged.

items.name: Prophet Robe
items.summary:
Prophet Robe is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prophet Set.
items.description:
Robe of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were
persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

The shackles around the neck warn passersby not to lend
an ear to their sermons.

details: Starting gear for the Prophet class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the second sentence.

items.name: Prophet Robe (Altered)
items.summary:
Prophet Robe (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prophet Set.

It is the altered form of Prophet Robe.
items.description:
Robe of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were
persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Made from rough fabric that scrapes against the skin like a
sharpening file.

details: Starting gear for the Prophet class (unaltered).
