Purchased unaltered from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).
Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the second sentence.

items.name: Corhyn's Robe
items.summary: Corhyn's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe of Corhyn the cleric.

Even after exile, Corhyn refused to recant his prophecies. And
for this, he was blessed with the guidance of grace.

Since then, the cart wheel draped on his neck has served as
a reminder. That true guidance awaits those with iron wills.
Those with unwavering faith.

details: Dropped by Brother Corhyn if killed.
If Corhyn's questline was not completed, it will appear at the last spot he was seen after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
If Corhyn was offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness it will be in his location in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, it will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital after speaking to him and reloading the area.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Robe
items.summary: Traveling Maiden Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Traveling Maiden Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Modest garb of traveling maidens, typically worn under their robes.

details: Found unaltered on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Finger Maiden Robe
items.summary: Finger Maiden Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Finger Maiden Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Finger Maiden Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

details: Found unaltered on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Dryleaf Robe
items.summary: Dryleaf Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.

The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect.

This sect rejects dependence on others in all matters of faith, seeking self-discipline and self-sufficiency above all else.

details: Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

notes: This item is part of Dane's Set.
Can be altered into the Dryleaf Robe (Altered).

items.name: Dryleaf Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Dryleaf Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.

The leather satchel hanging from the shoulder is decorated with one of Miquella's emblems, a golden grass motif.

details: Acquired from altering Dryleaf Robe.
→ Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

notes: This item is part of Dane's Set.
Can be altered into the Dryleaf Robe.

items.name: Sage Robe
items.summary: Sage Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick burgundy robe. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

details: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Goldmask's Rags
items.summary: Goldmask's Rags is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Worn rags that just barely cover the body.

Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excesses of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

details: Complete Goldmask's questline, then reload the area to loot the armor set from where you found him.

items.name: Perfumer Robe
items.summary: Perfumer Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

The thick front apron ambroidered with a depiction of the Erdtree is proof of mastery of the apothecarial arts, and its weight symbolizes the onus of both pride and responsibility.

details: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Perfumer Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Perfumer Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

The thick front apron ambroidered with a depiction of the Erdtree is proof of mastery of the apothecarial arts, and its weight symbolizes the onus of both pride and responsibility.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Perfumer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
items.summary: Perfumer's Traveling Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

The thick front apron, the badge of a perfumer, has been replaced with a more simple one made from soft leather.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (altered)
items.summary: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

The thick front apron, the badge of a perfumer, has been replaced with a more simple one made from soft leather.

details: Found unaltered on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
items.summary: Depraved Perfumer Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

details: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Depraved Perfumer Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Depraved Perfumer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Upper-Class Robe
items.summary: Upper-Class Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children. Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.

details: Bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau
Found on a corpse on a balcony in Leyndell, Royal Capital

items.name: Ruler's Robe
items.summary: Ruler's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation. Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.

details: Found on a corpse on a broken caravan near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Consort's Robe
items.summary: Consort's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor.

Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort. She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy.

In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

details: Dropped upon ending Tanith's questline.

items.name: Official's Attire
items.summary: Official's Attire is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Grubby blue robe worn by magisterial officials to carry out their grim tasks.

Surveillance, execution, gruesome rituals... The darkest duties drive the wheels of mankind.

details: Hidden within a room that you can only reach from the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace.

items.name: Marais Robe
items.summary: Marais Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais.

The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce godess who was born into rot.

details: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.

items.name: Fur Raiment
items.summary: Fur Raiment is a chest armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

details: Fur Raiment has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

items.name: Shaman Furs
items.summary: Shaman Furs are a chest armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

The ancestral followers live a distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

details: Shaman Furs have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Robe
items.summary: Godskin Apostle Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

details: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

items.name: Godskin Noble Robe
items.summary: Godskin Noble Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles, known for their seven-face aprons.

Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

details: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of the Noble Presence Incantation by 20% when worn.

items.name: Fell Omen Cloak
items.summary: Fell Omen Cloak is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed of Margit, the Fell Omen.

Having slaughtered countless champions during the Shattering, the Fell Omen has become a horror to those who harbor ambitions for the Erdtree, or for Lordship.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Morgott, the Omen King.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
items.summary: Sanguine Noble Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.

details: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees north west of Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Ansbach's Attire
items.summary: Ansbach's Attire is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Attire of Sir Ansbach. The embroidered crest of the Pureblood Knights has now all but faded away.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

Ansbach understood that keeping his oath to his old master was not an act of logic, nor would it bear any justice, but it was for these very reasons he was unable to let go.
effect_details: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by +3%

details: Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

notes: This item is part of Ansbach's Set.
Can be altered into Ansbach's Attire (Altered).

infobox.effects: Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills

items.name: Ansbach's Attire (Altered)
items.summary: Ansbach's Attire (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Attire of Sir Ansbach. Black cloth adorned with gold embroidery.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.
effect_details: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by +3%

details: Acquired from altering Ansbach's Attire.

→ Which can be obtained after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

notes: This item is part of Ansbach's Set.
Can be altered into Ansbach's Attire.

infobox.effects: Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills

items.name: Lord of Blood's Robe
items.summary: Lord of Blood's Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth.

The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Robe (Altered)
items.summary: Lord of Blood's Robe (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth.

The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

details: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood. Can be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.summary: Leather Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier.

Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

details: Drops from Patches.

items.name: Blue Cloth Vest
items.summary:
Blue Cloth Vest is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Blue Cloth Set.
items.description:
Vest of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes
brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its
wearer.

Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors
must remain ever drifting.

details: Starting gear for the Warrior class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

items.name: Noble's Traveling Garb
items.summary: Noble's Traveling Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Travelling attire fashioned from metallic white silk thread. Worn by expatriated royalty.

A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

details: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

items.name: War Surgeon Gown
items.summary: War Surgeon Gown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.

Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood.

None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception.

details: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace.

items.name: War Surgeon Gown
items.summary: War Surgeon Gown is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.

Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood.

None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception.

details: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace. Then, alter with Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Thiollier's Garb
items.summary: Thiollier's Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret.

The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane.

Additionally, countless needles are sewn onto the exterior, apparently for talismanic effect.
effect_details: Raises arcane by +2.

details: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

notes: This item is part of Thiollier's Set.
Can be altered into Thiollier's Garb (Altered).
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Thiollier's Garb (Altered)
items.summary: Thiollier's Garb (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret.

Countless needles are sewn onto the exterior for talismanic effect.

details: Acquired from altering Thiollier's Garb.
→ Which can be recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

notes: This item is part of Thiollier's Set.
Can be altered into Thiollier's Garb.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery
items.summary: Nomadic Merchant's Finery is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Finery of the nomadic merchants. Decorated with tiny gems in a wide spectrum of colors.

These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground.

Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

details: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery (Altered)
items.summary: Nomadic Merchant's Finery (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Finery of the nomadic merchants. Decorated with tiny gems in a wide spectrum of colors.

These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground.

Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

details: Found unaltered behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.
Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Bandit Garb
items.summary: Bandit Garb is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leather garb worn by bandits.

Light for ease of movement, and supple for masking sound. In
trade, they offer little damage negation.

details: Starting gear for the Bandit class.
Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,500 Runes.

notes: The Bandit Manchettes are part of the Bandit Set.

items.name: Confessor Armor
items.summary:
Confessor Armor is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Confessor Set.
items.description:
Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn
by church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the
teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the
guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to
hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

details: Starting gear for the Confessor class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

items.name: Confessor Armor (Altered)
items.summary:
Confessor Armor (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Confessor Set.

It is the altered form of Confessor Armor.
items.description:
Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn
by church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the
teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the
guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to
hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

details: Starting gear for the Confessor class (unaltered).
Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).
Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

items.name: Omenkiller Robe
items.summary: Omenkiller Robe is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience.

Its thick apron is worn in rememberance of Rollo, the progenitor of the Omenkillers and a perfumer of antiquity.

details: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
items.summary: Raptor's Black Feathers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey. Worn by the assassins of Ravenmount.

A ritual implement for transforming into a Deathbird, if only by imitation. Strengthens jump attacks.

"We are birds of prey, bringers of death."

details: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave.

notes: The Raptor's Black Feather's increases the Damage of jump attacks by +10% (+5% in PvP).
→ This stacks multiplicatively with the Claw Talisman.
→ This bonus only applies to melee attacks, so jump-firing from a bow or jump-casting a spell do not receive a damage bonus.
→ Raptor of the Mists is the only skill affected by this boost.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased the jumping attack damage buff granted by the Raptor's Black Feathers armor.
patch_notes.community_notes: The damage boost done to other players was lowered from +10% to +5%.

items.name: Gravebird Armor
items.summary: Gravebird Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

details: Located next to an arch-covered coffin, on a hill next to the rocky mountain walls, northwest of the entrance to Belurat Gaol.

notes: This item is part of the Gravebird Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor
items.summary: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird. Featuring a cape of black Deathbird feathers, it enhances jumping attacks.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.
effect_details: Increases the damage of jump attacks by the following amounts:
Raptor of the Mists is the only skill affected by this boost.

details: Found on a corpse on top of a hill that's littered with gravebird statues, by the river north of the Temple Town site of grace.

notes: This item is part of the Gravebird Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Dancer's Dress
items.summary: Dancer's Dress is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers. Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on.

To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.
effect_details: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by +2.5%.

details: Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Dancer's Set.
Can be altered into the Dancer's Dress (Altered).

items.name: Dancer's Dress (Altered)
items.summary: Dancer's Dress (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Altered form of the deep crimson dress of the Ranah dancers. These are the black undergarments worn beneath.

Enhances the power of dancing attacks.
effect_details: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by +2.5%.

details: Acquired from altering the Dancer's Dress.
→ Which can be obtained from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Dancer's Set.
Can be altered into the Dancer's Dress.

items.name: Foot Soldier Tabard
items.summary: Foot Soldier Tabard is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Leather-Draped Tabard
items.summary: Leather-Draped Tabard is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl drapped over the shoulders.

Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Chain-Draped Tabard
items.summary: Chain-Draped Tabard is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders.

Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

items.name: Ivory-Draped Tabard
items.summary: Ivory-Draped Tabard is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders.

Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Scarlet Tabard
items.summary: Scarlet Tabard is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot.

Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army.

details: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Bloodsoaked Tabard
items.summary: Bloodsoaked Tabard is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with indelible bloostains around the neck.

Worn by headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

details: Chance to drop from Mausoleum Foot Soldier enemies.

items.name: Highwayman Cloth Armor
items.summary: Highwayman Cloth Armor is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

details: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

items.name: Common Soldier Cloth Armor
items.summary: Common Soldier Cloth Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Cloth armor of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

acquisition.location: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Common Soldier Set.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Armor
items.summary: Vulgar Militia Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excized from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

details: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Armor
items.summary: Shadow Militiaman Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

notes: This item is part of the Shadow Militiaman Set.

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
items.summary: Gravekeeper Cloak is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, bristly cloak that is the symbol of an underground gravekeeper.

Those who once fought for a living were driven from the colosseum, and becoming guardians of Erdtree Burial.

details: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

If the player character's Body Type is Type A and switches to Type B through the Clouded Mirror Stand in Roundtable Hold or through Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon's cosmetics services while wearing this piece of armor there is a chance that the Type B-exclusive top ends up being temporarily changed to brown instead of it's normal gray color.

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered)
items.summary: Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Defensive wear encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

details: Can only be obtained unaltered as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

If the player character's Body Type is Type A and switches to Type B through the Clouded Mirror Stand in Roundtable Hold or through Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon's cosmetics services while wearing this piece of armor there is a chance that the Type B-exclusive top ends up being temporarily changed to brown instead of it's normal gray color.
Increases the wearer's target priority, making enemies far more likely to target the wearer at further distances.

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
items.summary: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot.

The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.

details: Dropped by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered)
items.summary: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Cloak wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot.

Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

details: Dropped unaltered by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.
Increases the wearer's target priority, making enemies far more likely to target the wearer at further distances.

items.name: Nox Monk Armor
items.summary: Nox Monk Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Nox Monk enemies.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Nox Monk Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Nox Monk Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Monk enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Armor
items.summary: Nox Swordstress Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and wear silk capes.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Nox Swordstress enemies.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Nox Swordstress Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Swordstress enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Night Maiden Armor
items.summary: Night Maiden Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Night Maiden enemies.

items.name: Champion Pauldron
items.summary:
Champion Pauldron is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Champion Set.
items.description:
Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the
wearer has slaughtered countless foes.

Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave
warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

details: Starting gear for the Hero class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

notes: This was the starting armor for the Champion class in the Closed Network Test with slightly different stats.

items.name: Highland Attire
items.summary: Highland Attire is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with a blue patterned cloth.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

details: Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear.

notes: This item is part of the Highland Warrior Set.
While this item cannot be altered on its own, it essentially acts as an altered version of the Gloried Attire, which can be found in a different location.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Gloried Attire
items.summary: Gloried Attire is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with fur. This garment is made from fabrics with both blue and red patterns.

Red-patterned fabrics were allowed only to those who hunted bears—the greatest and most glorious of the highlanders.

details: Acquired from a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, found in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

notes: This item is part of the Highland Warrior Set.
While this item cannot be altered on its own, it essentially acts as an unaltered version of the Highland Attire, which can be found in a different location.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Iron Rivet Armor
items.summary: Iron Rivet Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Chest armor of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. A vest reinforced with iron rivets.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength.

"I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

details: Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Iron Rivet Set and Red Bear Set.

items.name: Igon's Armor
items.summary: Igon's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set comprised of a miscellany of parts. Filthy belongings are attached to this tattered piece of protective-wear.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

details: Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline.

→ Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.)
→ This will make Igon appear just past the arena, exhaust his dialogue there until he gives Igon's Furled Finger.
→ Defeat Bayle the Dread at the top of the Jagged Peak (summoning Igon for the fight is optional).
→ After Bayle has been felled, return to the location where Igon gave his furled finger. As this item, along with several others, can now be recovered from his body.

notes: This item is part of Igon's Set.
Can be altered into Igon's Armor (Altered).
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Igon's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Igon's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

details: Acquired from altering Igon's Armor.
→ Which can be acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline.

→→ Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.)
→→ This will make Igon appear just past the arena, exhaust his dialogue there until he gives Igon's Furled Finger.
→→ Defeat Bayle the Dread at the top of the Jagged Peak (summoning Igon for the fight is optional).
→→ After Bayle has been felled, return to the location where Igon gave his furled finger. As this item, along with several others, can now be recovered from his body.

notes: This item is part of Igon's Set.
Can be altered into Igon's Armor.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Ascetic's Loincloth
items.summary: Ascetic's Loincloth is an armor piece in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Attire of the tower's ascetics, embodying their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

notes: This item is part of the Ascetic's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Chain Armor
items.summary: Chain Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

details: Sold by Kalé

items.name: Dirty Chainmail
items.summary: Dirty Chainmail is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefit worthy of note.

details: Chance to drop from Albinauric enemies that wield it.

items.name: Tree Surcoat
items.summary: Tree Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Blue surcoat draped over chainmail.

The tree insignia emblazoned on the front depicts the Erdtree, and is a design beloved throughout the Lands Between.

details: Bought from Nomadic Merchant (Altus Plateau).

items.name: Eye Surcoat
items.summary: The Eye Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Brown surcoat draped over chainmail.

The insignia emblazoned on the front marks out the wearer as the eyes and ears of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

details: Found on the ground in the arena of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

notes: The Eye Surcoat does not belong to any set.

items.name: Tree-and-Beast Surcoat
items.summary:
Tree-and-Beast Surcoat is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Soldier Set.
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an
emblem of the golden lineage. Both are symbols of glory now past.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

items.name: Cuckoo Surcoat
items.summary: Cuckoo Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.

The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone. To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

items.name: Redmane Surcoat
items.summary: Redmane Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.

The surcoat depicts a red-maned lion raising a sword in the image of Radahn. Thus, they were Redmanes, and all proved they were worthy of the name.

details: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

items.name: Erdtree Surcoat
items.summary: Erdtree Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Surcoat
items.summary: Haligtree Crest Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

The surcoat bears the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldiers.

items.name: Mausoleum Surcoat
items.summary: Mausoleum Surcoat is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The surcoat depicts the mausoleum bell, which rings in constant mourning for the soulless demigods.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Armor
items.summary: Messmer Soldier Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A ragged cloak is draped over rusted mail.

Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Messmer Soldier Set.
Can be altered into the Messmer Soldier Armor (Altered).

items.name: Messmer Soldier Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Messmer Soldier Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The mail has rusted while fighting in unending war.

Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

details: Acquired from altering Messmer Soldier Armor.
→ Which has a 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

notes: Has the exact same defenses and resistances as the unaltered version while being a whole 1.1 units lighter.
This item is part of the Messmer Soldier Set.
Can be altered into the Messmer Soldier Armor.

items.name: Scale Armor
items.summary: Scale Armor is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor reinforced with small metal scales.

The cape covering the shoulders is made with treated rock lizard skin, and provides ample protection against fire.

details: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

items.name: Exile Armor
items.summary: Exile Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

details: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

items.name: Kaiden Armor
items.summary: Kaiden Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by Kaiden sellswords. Made with the pelt of a snow-wolf, which protects against the cold.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the moutaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

details: Chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

items.name: Land of Reeds Armor
items.summary:
Land of Reeds Armor is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Land of Reeds Set.
items.description:
Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by
warriors of the Land of Reeds.

The grimy outer mantle is made from withered reeds from the
warrior's birthplace. Perhaps its comforts extend to nostalgic
thoughts of home.

details: Starting gear for the Samurai class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Land of Reeds Armor (Altered)
items.summary:
Land of Reeds Armor (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Land of Reeds Set.

It is the altered form of Land of Reeds Armor.
items.description:
Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by
warriors of the Land of Reeds.

The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil
war, during which time it has remained alienated from
the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation
has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

details: Starting gear for the Samurai class (unaltered).
Purchased unaltered from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).
Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: White Reed Armor
items.summary: White Reed Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by Inaba, head disciples of the great swordsman Okina.

The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothing more than to die by the sword.

details: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Ronin's Armor
items.summary: Ronin's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

details: Dropped by Shabriri on death, or left in his place if the Tarnished meets the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame. Will not be dropped by Yura if he is killed before Shabriri possesses him.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Ronin's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Ronin's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

details: Dropped by Yura (unaltered) only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Eccentric's Armor
items.summary: Eccentric's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Unusually colorful armor. Worn by the knight Jerren.

Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn.

And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

details: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

items.name: Freyja's Armor
items.summary: Freyja's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden armor of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights. Affixed with a black woolen mantle.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Redmane Freyja at either of the following locations:
details: Specimen Storehouse - If the player chooses to kill her by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, as it is the first location where she's vulnerable to being attacked.

→ Freyja can also simply be completely ignored, then this item will be left behind where she once was, once the player has engaged with the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight at least once. With no need to engage with her in combat.

→→ Note that Freyja dying or disappearing before the player has recieved the Golden Lion Shield from her, makes that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough (outside of having it be left by another player during online play). The player can however simply refrain from killing Freyja until after they've received the shield.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to give Freyja the Letter for Freyja key item at the Specimen Storehouse, without immediately killing her afterwards.
→ Freyja will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on her corpse, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

notes: This item is part of Freyja's Set.
Can be altered into Freyja's Armor (Altered).
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Armor
items.summary: Marionette Soldier Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of metal bands arranged in a lattice. Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this armor is remarkably crude, now rusted over and severely dented.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

details: Chance to drop from Marionette Soldier enemies.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor
items.summary: Blue Silver Mail Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

details: Chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

notes: It's altered version has exactly the same description.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Blue Silver Mail Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

details: Chance to drop unaltered from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Fire Monk Armor
items.summary: Fire Monk Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The grotesque face sculpted on the chest is said to depict the corrupt ancient god of the flame. Taboos transform into lasting obsessions by virtue of the fear that they inspire.

details: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Armor
items.summary: Blackflame Monk Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron armor adorned with ashen cloth. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

details: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

items.name: Zamor Armor
items.summary: Zamor Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants.

These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

details: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Black Knife Armor
items.summary: Black Knife Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound.

Traces of power yet remain in its conceiling veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

details: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

notes: Eliminates all sound made by the wearer.

items.name: Black Knife Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Black Knife Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

details: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield. The chest piece can then be altered at a site of grace or with the help of Boc.

items.name: Armor of Night
items.summary: Armor of Night is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bottomless black chest armor, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

details: Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol.

→ To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own. This elevator will first descend down to a stone bridge (which when followed, will progress towards the end of the dungeon) before automatically ascending back up again. Jumping back onto the jar-elevator as it ascends and staying on it until it reaches the top will eventually take the player to the section where this item can be found.

notes: This item is part of the Night Set.

items.name: Malenia's Armor
items.summary: Malenia's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Malenia's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Malenia's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

details: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Elden Lord Armor
items.summary: Elden Lord Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of Godfrey the first Elden Lord.

The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield.

He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

details: Gotten from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

items.name: Messmer's Armor
items.summary: Messmer's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Black armor of Messmer the Impaler. Draped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered.

On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.

"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

details: Can be bought for 15000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

notes: This item is part of Messmer's Set.

items.name: Knight Armor
items.summary:
Knight Armor is a chest armor in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Knight Set.
items.description:
Iron armor of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

details: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Armor
items.summary:
Vagabond Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Vagabond Knight Set.
items.description:
Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty
and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

The crest emblazoned on the front is worn and dingy, no
longer able to evoke sentiment.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant
damage negation.

details: Starting gear for the Vagabond class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Carian Knight Armor
items.summary: Carian Knight Armor is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

details: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

notes: The altered armor has exactly the the same description as the base armor.

items.name: Godrick Knight Armor
items.summary:
Godrick Knight Armor is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Knight Set
items.description:
Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an
emblem of the golden lineage. The knights surely boasted of
their strength in days long gone.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.summary: Cuckoo Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a peering cuckoo, whence came their name. Perhaps the bird's shrewd gaze is an expression of their refusal to be mere servants of the academy.

details: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Redmane Knight Armor
items.summary: Redmane Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

When they were driven to defeat by Malenia's scarlet rot, the Redmane Knights burned the crest on the left breast of their armor to indicate their resolve.

"Alas, dear home, I shan't see you again! For our duty is to remain here, a bulwark against the blight."

details: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Armor
items.summary: Gelmir Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard.

It bears an emblem that none wear any longer, standing as it does for a lord that fell from lofty ambition into gluttonous depravity. As the lord lost his dignity, so too did these knights lose their master.

details: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.summary:
Leyndell Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Leyndell Knight Set.
items.description:
Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship,
said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.description:
Armor worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.

Its left breast is emblazoned with the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor
items.summary: Mausoleum Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The wing-shaped ornament on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

details: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Black Knight Armor
items.summary: Black Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler.

Though the engraving above the heart is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

notes: This item is part of the Black Knight Set.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor
items.summary: Bloodhound Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Metal armor with a jutting breastplate. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

details: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

items.summary:
Cleanrot Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of the Cleanrot Set.
items.description:
Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

details: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Fire Knight Armor
items.summary: Fire Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck, enhancing incantations of Messmer's flame.

These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form.
effect_details: Increases damage of Messmer's Flame Incantations by +5%.

details: 3% chance of dropping from Fire Knights.

notes: This item is part of the Fire Knight Set.
Can be altered into the Fire Knight Armor (Altered), which removes the cape.

items.description:
Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

details: Acquired from altering the Fire Knight Armor.
→ Which has a 3% chance of dropping from Fire Knights.

notes: This item is part of the Fire Knight Set.
Fire Knight Queelign wears this version of the Fire Knight Armor.
Can be altered into the Fire Knight Armor, which adds the cape.
This version of the Fire Knight Armor loses out on the damage bonus to Messmer's Flame Incantations.

items.name: Death Knight Armor
items.summary: Death Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden armor of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.
effect_details: Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Incantations by +2%.
Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Skills by +2%.

details: Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer.
→ The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

→ Once at the bottom of the elevator, there will be large open room with a staired balcony on the eastern walls. Follow this balcony while keeping an eye on the guard rail, past the lionheaded imp until the path turns to the right. There will be an opening in the in the corner of the rail. This opening will lead to a drop down to a small ledge that'll immediately lead this hidden room.

notes: This item is part of the Death Knight Set.

items.name: Horned Warrior Armor
items.summary: Horned Warrior Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

The ochre fabric is draped over a chest-piece made to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

acquisition.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Horned Warrior Set.

items.name: Divine Beast Warrior Armor
items.summary: Divine Beast Warrior Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of feted horned warriors chosen to become divine beast warriors, adorned with a lion's pelt.

Among the divine beast warriors, only those who truly excel at divine invocation become sculpted keepers, and are granted the honor of the lion dance.

details: 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Beast Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Divine Beast Warrior Set.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Armor
items.summary: Divine Bird Warrior Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

details: 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Divine Bird Warrior Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Armor
items.summary: Oathseeker Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Oathseeker Knight chest armor. Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

details: Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

notes: This item is part of the Oathseeker Knight Set.
While this item cannot be altered on its own, it essentially acts as an altered version of Leda's Armor, which can be found in a different location.

items.name: Leda's Armor
items.summary: Leda's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Chest armor of Needle Knight Leda.

Slightly strengthens attacks following a dodge roll or backstep, as well as dash attacks.

Embroidered with a golden crossed-tree motif, the chalk white cloak and surcoat symbolize the honor of the Needle Knights.

"Kindly Miquella fashioned us as his needles to quell all, to ward away all."
effect_details: Increases the damage of rolling attacks, backstep attacks and dashing attacks by the following amounts:

details: Recovered from the body of Needle Knight Leda in the hallway after the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

notes: This item is part of Leda's Set.
While this item cannot be altered on its own, it essentially acts as an unaltered version of Oathseeker Knight Armor, which can be found in a different location.

items.name: Raging Wolf Armor
items.summary:
Raging Wolf Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Raging Wolf Set.
items.description:
Armor worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

details: Defeat Vargram the Raging Wolf.

notes: This item was originally called "Bloody Wolf Armor" in the Closed Network Test and was part of the set worn by the test-only class, Bloody Wolf.
The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Raging Wolf Armor
items.summary:
Raging Wolf Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Raging Wolf Set.
items.description:
Armor worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

details: Defeat Vargram the Raging Wolf and modify with Boc.

notes: This item was originally called "Bloody Wolf Armor" in the Closed Network Test and was part of the set worn by the test-only class, Bloody Wolf.
The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Hoslow's Armor
items.summary: Hoslow's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

details: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Hoslow's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Hoslow's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

details: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants. Altered by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Twinned Armor
items.summary: Twinned Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are two bodies and two minds, but a single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

details: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Due to the silver head protruding from the armor, weapons that rest on the right shoulder while two-handing will be held straight across the shoulder rather than at an angle like most other armors.

items.name: Twinned Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Twinned Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are two bodies and two minds, but a single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.
