details: Dropped unaltered upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Due to the silver head protruding from the armor, weapons that rest on the right shoulder while two-handing will be held straight across the shoulder rather than at an angle like most other armors.

items.name: Drake Knight Armor
items.summary: Drake Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.

details: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Drake Knight Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Drake Knight Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

details: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Blaidd's Armor
items.summary: Blaidd's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd.

The pelt serves as a cape, protecting from cold. Blaidd was the blade of Ranni, but the cold bothered him anyway.

details: Obtained from Blaidd with the rest of his armor set after killing him at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline.

items.name: Blaidd's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Blaidd's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd.

Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.

details: Received unaltered after killing Blaidd at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

items.name: Briar Armor
items.summary:
Briar Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Briar Set.
items.description:
Battered iron armor from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

notes: Deals 25 Standard physical damage if colliding with an enemy when rolling.
Its altered version has exactly the same description.

items.name: Briar Armor (Altered)
items.summary:
Briar Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Briar Set.
items.description:

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

notes: Deals 25 Standard physical damage if colliding with an enemy when rolling.

items.name: Fingerprint Armor
items.summary:
Fingerprint Armor is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fingerprint Set.
items.description:
Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

details: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Fingerprint Armor (Altered)
items.summary:
Fingerprint Armor (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fingerprint Set.

details: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Rakshasa Armor
items.summary: Rakshasa Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Armor of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.
effect_details: Increases attack power +2%.
Reduces damage negation by -2%.

details: Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Rakshasa Set.

items.name: Royal Remains Armor
items.summary: Royal Remains Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly resplenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

details: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

notes: Restores 2 HP per second when the wearer is at below 18% of their maximum health. The restoration effects stop once their health raises past the threshold.

items.name: All-Knowing Armor
items.summary: All-Knowing Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

details: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: All-Knowing Armor (Altered)
items.summary: All-Knowing Armor (altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

Armor set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

details: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Royal Knight Armor
items.summary: Royal Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta was once a royal Carian knight, and her lapis-lazuli blue cape is the emblem of the knightly pride that continues to guide her.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Royal Knight Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Royal Knight Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

details: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version description differs from the normal description.

items.name: Rellana's Armor
items.summary: Rellana's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

Adorned with the lapis-lazuli blue that is symbolic of Caria, its radiance is yet to fully fade.

details: Can be bought for 15000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

notes: This item is part of Rellana's Set.

items.name: Maliketh's Armor
items.summary: Maliketh's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

details: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Maliketh's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Maliketh's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

details: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Banished Knight Armor
items.summary: Banished Knight Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

details: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one accompanied by two wolves in Castle Sol.

notes: The Japanese name 失地騎士 (shicchi kishi), literally meaning "knights who have lost their land to an enemy", implies that the "Banished Knights" have been driven from their homeland by force.

items.name: Banished Knight Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Banished Knight Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

details: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it. Cannot be obtained by altering it yourself.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Armor
items.summary: Night's Cavalry Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

details: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Night's Cavalry Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

details: Received unaltered upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Armor of Solitude
items.summary: Armor of Solitude is an armor piece in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel, and bedecked with a black cloak.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

details: Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Solitude Set.
Can be altered into the Armor of Solitude (Altered).

items.name: Armor of Solitude (Altered)
items.summary: Armor of Solitude (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.

Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

details: Acquired from altering the Armor of Solitude.
→ Which can be obtained from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Solitude Set.
Can be altered into the Armor of Solitude.

items.name: Veteran's Armor
items.summary: Veteran's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Veteran's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Veteran's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

details: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Scaled Armor
items.summary: Scaled Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

details: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Scaled Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Scaled Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

details: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor to receive it unaltered. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Beast Champion Armor
items.summary: Beast Champion Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

details: Altered version is received upon:
Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.
Needs to be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

items.name: Beast Champion Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Beast Champion Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
items.summary: Tree Sentinel Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Adorned with a cape featuring the mark of the sacred tree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

details: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

notes: The description of the altered version simply removes the cape's depiction.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Tree Sentinel Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

details: Received unaltered upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The description of the altered version simply removes the cape's depiction.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
items.summary: Malformed Dragon Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

details: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Crucible Axe Armor
items.summary: Crucible Axe Armor is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

details: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.

notes: Crucible Axe Armor can be modified by Boc the Seamster or with Tailoring Tools at any site of grace.
→ The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Crucible Axe Armor (altered)
items.summary: Crucible Axe Armor (Altered) is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

details: Received as Crucible Axe Armor after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau. Crucible Axe Armor be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: Crucible Axe Armor (Altered) can be modified by Boc the Seamster or with Tailoring Tools at any site of grace.
→ The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Crucible Tree Armor
items.summary: Crucible Tree Armor is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Siluria and her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

details: Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

notes: Crucible Tree Armor can be modified by Boc the Seamster or with Tailoring Tools at any site of grace.
→ The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Crucible Tree Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Crucible Tree Armor (Altered) is a chest armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Siluria and her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

details: Received as Crucible Tree Armor after looting a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths. Crucible Tree Armor be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: Crucible Tree Armor (Altered) can be modified by Boc the Seamster or with Tailoring Tools at any site of grace.
→ The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.
Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Gaius's Armor
items.summary: Gaius's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The black iron chest armor of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.

Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

details: Can be bought for 12000 from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Commander Gaius.

notes: This item is part of Gaius's Set.

items.name: Radahn's Lion Armor
items.summary: Radahn's Lion Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Radahn's Lion Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Radahn's Lion Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Armor depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

details: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

notes: The altered version has the exact same description as the normal version.

items.name: Young Lion's Armor
items.summary: Young Lion's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The golden armor worn by Radahn in his younger years. Proudly adorned with heroic red accents, it is fitting attire for a lion.

When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear—

"Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

details: Can be bought for 20000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

notes: This item is part of the Young Lion's Set.
Can be altered into the Young Lion's Armor (Altered).

items.name: Young Lion's Armor (Altered)
items.summary: Young Lion's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The golden armor worn by Radahn in his younger years. Worn by a fierce lion.

When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear—

"Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

details: Acquired from altering the Young Lion's Armor
Can be bought for 20000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

notes: This item is part of the Young Lion's Set.
Can be altered into the Young Lion's Armor.

items.name: Lionel's Armor
items.summary:
Lionel's Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Lionel's Set.

It is the normal version of Lionel's Armor (Altered).
items.description:
Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

details: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Lionel's Armor (Altered)
items.summary:
Lionel's Armor (Altered) is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of Lionel's Set.

It is the altered version of Lionel's Armor.
items.description:
Round iron armor. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

details: Gained by altering Lionel's Armor, which is found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Bull-Goat Armor
items.summary: Bull-Goat Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

details: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

notes: This is part of the Bull-Goat Set.
The Bull-Goat Armor is the heaviest chest armor piece in the game.

items.name: Verdigris Armor
items.summary: Verdigris Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Chest armor made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:
details: Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever".

→ Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood. Here, this item can be safely recovered from his body, with no need for a fight.
Enir-Ilim - If the player selects "Put it behind you" when talking to Moore.
→ Moore will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his body, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

acquisition.location: / Scadu Altus - The player can also get this item from killing Moore when he invades as retribution for the murder of two forager brood members.
details: Note that Moore will not drop his bell bearing if killed in this manner, thus making that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough.

notes: This item is part of the Verdigris Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Omen Armor
items.summary: Omen Armor is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed armor resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater. The heavy, sun-shaped medallion represents both the guidance he once saw, and the ring to which it will one day lead.

details: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

notes: Increases the damage of the Omen Bairn and the Regal Omen Bairn, as well as the heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks during the effect of Shriek of Milos, by 5%.

items.name: Fire Prelate Armor
items.summary:
Fire Prelate Armor is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fire Prelate Set.
items.description:
Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire
Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

details: Dropped by Fire Prelates.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Fire Prelate Armor (Altered)
items.summary:
Fire Prelate Armor (Altered) is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fire Prelate Set.

It is the altered form of Fire Prelate Armor.
items.description:
Black iron armor. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders
of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity.

details: Dropped by the Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

notes: The altered version description slightly differs in the very first sentence.

items.name: Traveler's Manchettes
items.summary: Traveler's Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Light yet sturdy leather manchettes.

Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

details: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

items.name: Guardian Bracers
items.summary: Guardian Bracers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Engraved golden bracers. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it.

items.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
items.summary: Bloodsoaked Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood.

Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.

details: Found on a corpse near the Underground Roadsite site of grace located in the sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Braided Arm Wraps
items.summary: Braided Arm Wraps is is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Ragged black cloth tied with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.

acquisition.location: from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:
details: Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him.
→ This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.
→ Their signs will then become available to choose between at the top of the staircase found northeast of the Main Gate Plaza site of grace.
→ This option becomes inaccessible after defeating Messmer the Impaler.
Ancient Ruins of Rauh - If the player chooses to summon the Hornsent in the fight against Messmer.
→ The Hornsent will then invade the player at the top of the staircase in one of the rot-infested halls near the Church of the Bud in the southwestern quarters of Rauh.
→ Defeating him here will yield the player this item.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to defeat Messmer without the Hornsent's assistance.
→ The Hornsent will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his corpse, which can then be found in the arena after the battle is over.

notes: This item is part of the Hornsent Set.

items.name: Mushroom Arms
items.summary: Mushroom Arms is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the arms.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestements that root one to the earth.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Astrologer Gloves
items.summary:
Astrologer Gloves is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Astrologer Set
items.description:
Gloves fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look
to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the
glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

details: Starting gear for the Astrologer class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

items.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
items.summary: Sorcerer Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.

items.name: Battlemage Manchettes
items.summary: Battlemage Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Manchettes worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefied.

details: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
items.summary: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Commonplace leather manchettes. Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.

details: Found on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Spellblade's Gloves
items.summary: Spellblade's Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

details: Drops from Rogier.

notes: Increases Magic damage from Skills by 2%.

items.name: Alberich's Bracers
items.summary: Alberich's Bracers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's bracers.

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthen thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

details: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

notes: Increases the damage of Thorn Sorceries by 6%.

items.name: Preceptor's Gloves
items.summary: Preceptor's Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gloves of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

details: Found after advancing Ranni's questline until Seluvis dies, inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: High Priest Gloves
items.summary: High Priest Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Gloves of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.

details: Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.
→ To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral.
→ This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.
→ Vanquishing Jolan will then get Ymir to appear by the throne to challenge the player. Defeating Ymir will then reward the player with this item, among several others.

notes: This item is part of the High Priest Set.

items.name: Azur's Manchettes
items.summary: Azur's Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Manchettes corroded by blue-green glintstones. Worn by Azur, primeval current sorcerer.

Azur had reached a near-inorganic state.

details: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.

items.name: Lusat's Manchettes
items.summary: Lusat's Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones. Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

Lusat had reached a near-inorganic state.

details: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

items.name: Queen's Bracelets
items.summary: Queen's Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Gloves
items.summary: Traveling Maiden Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gloves worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Dryleaf Arm Wraps
items.summary: Dryleaf Arm Wraps is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled arm wraps.

Wound tightly around the arms as if it might prevent them from being broken.

details: Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

notes: This item is part of Dane's Set.

items.name: Gold Bracelets
items.summary: Gold Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made by Lord Goldmask's disciples.

Those disciples have long since left him.

details: Finish Goldmask's questline.

items.name: Perfumer Gloves
items.summary: Perfumer Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times of past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

details: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

items.name: Traveler's Gloves
items.summary: Traveler's Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Gloves
items.summary: Depraved Perfumer Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

details: 3% chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Bracelets
items.summary: Godskin Apostle Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black bracelets of the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

details: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

items.name: Godskin Noble Bracelets
items.summary: Godskin Noble Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black bracelets of the Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

details: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

items.name: Ansbach's Manchettes
items.summary: Ansbach's Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Manchettes of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.
effect_details: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by +3%

details: Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

notes: This item is part of Ansbach's Set.

infobox.effects: Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.summary: Leather Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Lightweight and battle-proven leather gloves worn by a savvy soldier.

Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

details: Patches armor.

items.name: Warrior Gauntlets
items.summary:
Warrior Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Blue Cloth Set.
items.description: Gauntlets of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

details: Starting gear for the Warrior class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

items.name: Noble's Gloves
items.summary: Noble's Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gloves of plush leather. Worn by expatriated royalty.

A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

details: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

items.name: War Surgeon Gloves
items.summary: War Surgeon Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bloodstained white gloves of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.

Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception.

details: Dropped by an Unnamed White Mask invader at the blood river near Mohgwyn Palace.

items.name: Thiollier's Gloves
items.summary: Thiollier's Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: The dark gloves of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

details: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

notes: This item is part of Thiollier's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Bandit Manchettes
items.summary: Bandit Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Manchettes made by simply wrapping dirty cloth around
the arms. Worn by bandits.

details: Starting gear for the Bandit class.
Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,000 Runes.

notes: The Bandit Manchettes is part of the Bandit Set.

items.name: Confessor Gloves
items.summary:
Confessor Gloves is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Confessor Set.
items.description:
Black leather gloves of the church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the
teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the
guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to
hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

details: Starting gear for the Confessor class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

items.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
items.summary: Omenkiller Long Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Long, stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

details: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Gravebird Bracelets
items.summary: Gravebird Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Stone bracelets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

details: Found on a corpse that's seated on a stone platform, located on the road between the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace and the Supressing Pillar.

notes: This item is part of the Gravebird Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Dancer's Bracer
items.summary: Dancer's Bracer is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Metal bracer of the Ranah dancers.

Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

Designed to protect the sword-wielding hand.
effect_details: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by +2.5%.

details: Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Dancer's Set.

items.name: Foot Soldier Gauntlets
items.summary: Foot Soldier Gauntlets is a piece of arm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

items.name: Highwayman Gauntlets
items.summary: Highwayman Gauntlets is a piece of arm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: Hideously stained and dented gauntlets. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

details: 3% chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

items.name: Common Soldier Gauntlets
items.summary: Common Soldier Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

acquisition.location: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Common Soldier Set.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Gauntlets
items.summary: Vulgar Militia Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excized from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

details: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Gauntlets
items.summary: Shadow Militiaman Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

notes: This item is part of the Shadow Militiaman Set.

items.name: Nox Bracelets
items.summary: Nox Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Monastic bracelets of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: 3% chance to drop from Nox Monk, Nox Swordstress, and Nox Nightmaiden enemies in Nokron and Nokstella.

items.name: Champion Bracers
items.summary:
Champion Bracers is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Champion Set.
items.description:
Bracers reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the
wearer has slaughtered countless foes.

Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave
warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

details: Starting gear for the Hero class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

notes: This item was originally called "Champion Gauntlets" in the Closed Network Test.

items.name: Leather Arm Wraps
items.summary: Leather Arm Wraps is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Arm wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

details: Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear.
Also found on a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

notes: This item is part of the Highland Warrior Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Iron Rivet Gauntlets
items.summary: Iron Rivet Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength.

"I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

details: Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Iron Rivet Set and Red Bear Set.

items.name: Igon's Gauntlets
items.summary: Igon's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Gauntlets of the broken drake warrior Igon. No more than a mish-mash of tatters and remnants stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle.

details: Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline.

→ Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.)
→ This will make Igon appear just past the arena, exhaust his dialogue there until he gives Igon's Furled Finger.
→ Defeat Bayle the Dread at the top of the Jagged Peak (summoning Igon for the fight is optional).
→ After Bayle has been felled, return to the location where Igon gave his furled finger. As this item, along with several others, can now be recovered from his body.

notes: This item is part of Igon's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Ascetic's Wrist Guards
items.summary: Ascetic's Wrist Guards is an armor piece in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Wrist guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

notes: This item is part of the Ascetic's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Chain Gauntlets
items.summary: Chain Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

details: Sold by Kalé

items.name: Iron Gauntlets
items.summary: Iron Gauntlets is a piece of arm armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: :Ordinary iron gauntlets.

details: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region

items.name: Godrick Soldier Gauntlets
items.summary:
Godrick Soldier Gauntlets is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Soldier Set.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop by Godrick Soldier enemies.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Gauntlets
items.summary: Raya Lucarian Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets
items.summary: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets
items.summary: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Gauntlets
items.summary: Haligtree Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

items.name: Mausoleum Gauntlets
items.summary: Mausoleum Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Gauntlets
items.summary: Messmer Soldier Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Messmer Soldier Set.

items.name: Exile Gauntlets
items.summary: Exile Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Damaged iron gauntlets. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

details: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

items.name: Kaiden Gauntlets
items.summary: Kaiden Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the moutaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

details: 3% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

items.name: Land of Reeds Gauntlets
items.summary:
Land of Reeds Gauntlets is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Land of Reeds Set.
items.description:
Gauntlets wrapped in tough leather. Worn by warriors of
the Land of Reeds.

details: Starting gear for the Samurai class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

items.name: White Reed Gauntlets
items.summary: White Reed Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by Inaba, head disciples of the great swordsman Okina.

The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothing more than to die by the sword.

details: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
items.summary: Ronin's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

details: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

items.name: Eccentric's Manchettes
items.summary: Eccentric's Manchettes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The knight Jerren's manchettes.

Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn.

And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

details: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

items.name: Freyja's Gauntlets
items.summary: Freyja's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden gauntlets of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Redmane Freyja at either of the following locations:
details: Specimen Storehouse - If the player chooses to kill her by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, as it is the first location where she's vulnerable to being attacked.

→ Freyja can also simply be completely ignored, then this item will be left behind where she once was, once the player has engaged with the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight at least once. With no need to engage with her in combat.

→→ Note that Freyja dying or disappearing before the player has recieved the Golden Lion Shield from her, makes that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough (outside of having it be left by another player during online play). The player can however simply refrain from killing Freyja until after they've received the shield.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to give Freyja the Letter for Freyja key item at the Specimen Storehouse, without immediately killing her afterwards.
→ Freyja will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on her corpse, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

notes: This item is part of Freyja's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Blue Silver Bracelets
items.summary: Blue Silver Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bracelets crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

details: 2% chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

items.name: Fire Monk Gauntlets
items.summary: Fire Monk Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

details: 3% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Gauntlets
items.summary: Blackflame Monk Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

details: 3% chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

items.name: Zamor Bracelets
items.summary: Zamor Bracelets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bracelets worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants.

These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

details: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Black Knife Gauntlets
items.summary: Black Knife Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

details: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Gauntlets of Night
items.summary: Gauntlets of Night is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bottomless black gauntlets, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

details: Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol.

→ To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own. This elevator will first descend down to a stone bridge (which when followed, will progress towards the end of the dungeon) before automatically ascending back up again. Jumping back onto the jar-elevator as it ascends and staying on it until it reaches the top will eventually take the player to the section where this item can be found.

notes: This item is part of the Night Set.

items.name: Malenia's Gauntlet
items.summary: Malenia's Gauntlet is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlet made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

items.name: Elden Lord Bracers
items.summary: Elden Lord Bracers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bracers of Godfrey the first Elden Lord.

The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield.

He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

details: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

items.name: Messmer's Gauntlets
items.summary: Messmer's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Black gauntlets of Messmer the Impaler.

On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.

"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

details: Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

notes: This item is part of Messmer's Set.

items.name: Knight Gauntlets
items.summary:
Knight Gauntlets is an arm armor in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Knight Set.
items.description:
Iron gauntlets of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

details: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Gauntlets
items.summary:
Vagabond Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Vagabond Knight Set.
items.description:
Gauntlets of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and
battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant
damage negation.

details: Starting gear for the Vagabond class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

items.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Carian Knight Gauntlets are hand armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

details: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Godrick Knight Gauntlets
items.summary:
Godrick Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Knight Set
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time
has yet to dull their luster.

details: 3% chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: 3% chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

items.name: Redmane Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Redmane Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Black iron gauntlets worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: 3% chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Gauntlets
items.summary:
Leyndell Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Leyndell Knight Set.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: 3% chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Gauntlets worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

items.name: Black Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Black Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

notes: This item is part of the Black Knight Set.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Metal gauntlets of the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

details: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

items.name: Cleanrot Gauntlets
items.summary:
Cleanrot Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of the Cleanrot Set.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

details: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

items.name: Fire Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Fire Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

details: 3% chance of dropping from Fire Knights.

notes: This item is part of the Fire Knight Set.

items.name: Death Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Death Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden gauntlets of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.
effect_details: Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Incantations by +2%.
Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Skills by +2%.

details: Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer.
→ The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

→ Once at the bottom of the elevator, there will be large open room with a staired balcony on the eastern walls. Follow this balcony while keeping an eye on the guard rail, past the lionheaded imp until the path turns to the right. There will be an opening in the in the corner of the rail. This opening will lead to a drop down to a small ledge that'll immediately lead this hidden room.

notes: This item is part of the Death Knight Set.

items.name: Horned Warrior Gauntlets
items.summary: Horned Warrior Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Gauntlets of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower, made from a thick metal.

acquisition.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Horned Warrior Set.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets
items.summary: Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

details: 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Divine Bird Warrior Set.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Oathseeker Knight gauntlets. Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

details: Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

notes: This item is part of the Oathseeker Knight Set and Leda's Set.

items.name: Raging Wolf Gauntlets
items.summary:
Raging Wolf Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Raging Wolf Set.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

details: Murder Vargram the Raging Wolf.

notes: This item was originally called "Bloody Wolf Gauntlets" in the Closed Network Test and was part of the set worn by the test-only class, Bloody Wolf.

items.name: Hoslow's Gauntlets
items.summary: Hoslow's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garish silver gauntlets decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

details: Murder Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

items.name: Twinned Gauntlets
items.summary: Twinned Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are two bodies and two minds, but a single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

details: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

items.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Drake Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

details: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

items.name: Blaidd's Gauntlets
items.summary: Blaidd's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Well-worn black gauntlets of the man-wolf Blaidd.

Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.

details: Obtained from Blaidd with the rest of his armor set after killing him at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline.

items.name: Briar Gauntlets
items.summary:
Briar Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Briar Set.
items.description:
Battered gauntlets from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

notes: Deals 18 Standard physical damage if colliding with an enemy when rolling.

items.name: Fingerprint Gauntlets
items.summary:
Fingerprint Gauntlets is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fingerprint Set.
items.description:
Iron gauntlets singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

details: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Rakshasa Gauntlets
items.summary: Rakshasa Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.
effect_details: Increases attack power +2%.
Reduces damage negation by -2%.

details: Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Rakshasa Set.

items.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
items.summary: Royal Remains Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly resplenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

details: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

notes: Restores 2 HP per second when the wearer is at below 18% of their maximum health. The restoration effects stop once their health raises past the threshold.

items.name: All-Knowing Gauntlets
items.summary: All-Knowing Gauntlets is an armor piece in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

details: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

items.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Royal Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

items.name: Rellana's Gloves
items.summary: Rellana's Gloves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Gloves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from quality leather.
