details: Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

notes: This item is part of Rellana's Set.

items.name: Maliketh's Gauntlets
items.summary: Maliketh's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Beast's gauntlets made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

details: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Banished Knight Gauntlets
items.summary: Banished Knight Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These gauntlets were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all acomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

details: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Gauntlets
items.summary: Night's Cavalry Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Pitch-black gauntlets thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

details: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Gauntlets of Solitude
items.summary: Gauntlets of Solitude is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Steel gauntlets of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

details: Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Solitude Set.

items.name: Veteran's Gauntlets
items.summary: Veteran's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Old gauntlets that have seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

items.name: Scaled Gauntlets
items.summary: Scaled Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

details: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Beast Champion Gauntlets
items.summary: Beast Champion Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver gauntlets engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

details: Received upon:
Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
items.summary: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

details: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets
items.summary: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed golden gauntlets. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

details: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Crucible Gauntlets
items.summary: Crucible Gauntlets are gauntlets in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

details: Received after beating Crucible Knight Duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau
Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

notes: Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Gaius's Gauntlets
items.summary: Gaius's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The black iron gauntlets of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.

Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

details: Can be bought for 8000 from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Commander Gaius.

notes: This item is part of Gaius's Set.

items.name: Radahn's Gauntlets
items.summary: Radahn's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Gauntlets depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Young Lion's Gauntlets
items.summary: Young Lion's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The golden gauntlets worn by Radahn in his younger years.

When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear—

"Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

details: Can be bought for 12000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

notes: This item is part of the Young Lion's Set.

items.name: Lionel's Gauntlets
items.summary:
Lionel's Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of Lionel's Set.
items.description:
Rounded iron gauntlets. Worn by Lionel the Lionheated.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

details: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Bull-Goat Gauntlets
items.summary: Bull-Goat Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's gauntlets, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provide high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

details: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

notes: This is part of the Bull-Goat Set.
The Bull-Goat Armor is the heaviest arm armor piece in the game.

items.name: Verdigris Gauntlets
items.summary: Verdigris Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Gauntlets made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:
details: Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever".

→ Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood. Here, this item can be safely recovered from his body, with no need for a fight.
Enir-Ilim - If the player selects "Put it behind you" when talking to Moore.
→ Moore will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his body, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

acquisition.location: / Scadu Altus - The player can also get this item from killing Moore when he invades as retribution for the murder of two forager brood members.
details: Note that Moore will not drop his bell bearing if killed in this manner, thus making that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough.

notes: This item is part of the Verdigris Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Omen Gauntlets
items.summary: Omen Gauntlets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed gauntlets resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, their form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence? What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all.

details: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

notes: Increases the damage of the Omen Bairn and the Regal Omen Bairn, as well as the heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks during the effect of Shriek of Milos, by 5%.

items.name: Fire Prelate Gauntlets
items.summary:
Fire Prelate Gauntlets is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fire Prelate Set.
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets with the appearance of flames. Attire of
the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity.

details: 5% drop from Fire Prelates.

items.name: Cloth Trousers
items.summary: Cloth Trousers is a leg armor in Elden Ring.
items.description: Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

details: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

items.name: Traveler's Boots
items.summary: Traveler's Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Light yet sturdy leather boots.

Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

details: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

items.name: Commoner's Shoes
items.summary: Commoner's Shoes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners in the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

details: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

items.name: Aristocrat Boots
items.summary: Aristocrat Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Boots made from tanned leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

details: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. The Sorcerer variant and the variant that carries the torch or the Noble's Slender Sword all wear them.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Shoes
items.summary: Old Aristocrat Shoes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Hard-wearing shoes made of leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.
Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

details: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

items.name: Page Trousers
items.summary: Page Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Trousers worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

details: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

items.name: Guardian Greaves
items.summary: Guardian Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Engraved golden greaves. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

details: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

items.name: Prisoner Trousers
items.summary:
Prisoner Trousers is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prisoner Set.
items.description:
Tattered trousers. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling
crime.

Never once washed, every fiber is filthy. The smell is beyond
belief.

details: Starting gear for the Prisoner class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

items.name: Soiled Loincloth
items.summary: Soiled Loincloth is is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: This lightly soiled loincloth of ragged cloth does little more than conceal one's nether regions.

acquisition.location: from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:
details: Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him.
→ This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.
→ Their signs will then become available to choose between at the top of the staircase found northeast of the Main Gate Plaza site of grace.
→ This option becomes inaccessible after defeating Messmer the Impaler.
Ancient Ruins of Rauh - If the player chooses to summon the Hornsent in the fight against Messmer.
→ The Hornsent will then invade the player at the top of the staircase in one of the rot-infested halls near the Church of the Bud in the southwestern quarters of Rauh.
→ Defeating him here will yield the player this item.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to defeat Messmer without the Hornsent's assistance.
→ The Hornsent will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his corpse, which can then be found in the arena after the battle is over.

notes: This item is part of the Hornsent Set.

items.name: Mushroom Legs
items.summary: Mushroom Legs is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the legs.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestements that root one to the earth.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Astrologer Trousers
items.summary:
Astrologer Trousers is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Astrologer Set.
items.description:
Trousers worn inside a robe. Worn by those who look
to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the
glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

details: Starting gear for the Astrologer class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

items.name: Sorcerer Leggings
items.summary: Sorcerer Leggings is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

items.name: Battlemage Legwraps
items.summary: Battlemage Legwraps is an armor piece found in Elden Ring. Battlemage Legwraps is part of the Battlemage Set, which drops in its entirety the first time the player defeats a specific Battlemage located east of West Windmill Pasture.
items.description: Legwraps worn by the scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

details: A specific Battlemage enemy in Altus Plateau drops the Battlemage Legwraps the first time they are defeated. They are located directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace, east of West Windmill Pasture, up on a hill behind the bridge where the player first meets Goldmask.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Boots
items.summary: Errant Sorcerer Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Commonplace leather boots, sturdy enough to withstand a long journey.

details: Found on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Spellblade's Trousers
items.summary: Spellblade's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's trousers, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthen glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

details: Finish Sorcerer Rogier's questline.

notes: Increases Magic damage from Skills by 2%.

items.name: Alberich's Trousers
items.summary: Alberich's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's trousers.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

details: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Preceptor's Trousers
items.summary: Preceptor's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

details: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Old Sorcerer's Legwraps
items.summary: Old Sorcerer's Legwraps is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Ragged waistcloth that extends to the thighs. Common amongst old-fashioned sorcerers.

details: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

items.name: Queen's Leggings
items.summary: Queen's Leggings is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

items.name: Snow Witch Skirt
items.summary: Snow Witch Skirt is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Witch's skirt in the color of snow.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

details: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

items.name: High Priest Undergarments
items.summary: High Priest Undergarments is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Undergarments of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.

details: Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.
→ To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral.
→ This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.
→ Vanquishing Jolan will then get Ymir to appear by the throne to challenge the player. Defeating Ymir will then reward the player with this item, among several others.

notes: This item is part of the High Priest Set.

items.name: Prophet Trousers
items.summary:
Prophet Trousers is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Prophet Set.
items.description:
Trousers of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were
persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Made from rough fabric that scrapes against the skin like a
sharpening file.

details: Starting gear for the Prophet class.
Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

items.name: Traveling Maiden Boots
items.summary: Traveling Maiden Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Boots worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Finger Maiden Shoes
items.summary: Finger Maiden Shoes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Shoes worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

details: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Sage Trousers
items.summary: Sage Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick burgundy trousers. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

details: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Dryleaf Cuissardes
items.summary: Dryleaf Cuissardes is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. Boots made of sturdy leather.

details: Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

notes: This item is part of Dane's Set.

items.name: Gold Waistwrap
items.summary: Gold Waistwrap is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Waistwrap made in the image of Erdtree branches. A minimal adornment made by Lord Goldmask's disciples.

Those disciples have long since left him.

items.name: Perfumer Sarong
items.summary: Perfumer Sarong is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times of past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

details: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

items.name: Traveler's Slops
items.summary: Traveler's Slops is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Slops of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

details: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Trousers
items.summary: Depraved Perfumer Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Trousers worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

details: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

items.name: Consort's Trousers
items.summary: Consort's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Fine white trousers, perfectly suited for wearing beneath a silk robe.

details: Can be bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau
Dropped upon ending Tanith's questline

items.name: Fur Leggings
items.summary: Fur Leggings are a leg armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leggings fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

details: Fur Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

items.name: Shaman Leggings
items.summary: Shaman Leggings are a leg armor found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

The ancestral followers live a distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

details: Shaman Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Trousers
items.summary: Godskin Apostle Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

details: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

items.name: Godskin Noble Trousers
items.summary: Godskin Noble Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Trousers made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

details: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Waistcloth
items.summary: Sanguine Noble Waistcloth is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Waistcloth sewn from black cloth. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

details: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees northwest of Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Ansbach's Boots
items.summary: Ansbach's Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Boots of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.
effect_details: Enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills by +3%

details: Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

notes: This item is part of Ansbach's Set.

infobox.effects: Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills

items.name: Leather Trousers
items.summary: Leather Trousers is a leg armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Well-made leather trousers.

The lower legs are each bound in cord for ease of movement.

details: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region

items.name: Leather Boots
items.summary: Leather Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Lightweight and battle-proven leather boots worn by a savvy soldier.

Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

details: Patches armor.

items.name: Warrior Greaves
items.summary:
Warrior Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Blue Cloth Set.
items.description: Greaves of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

details: Starting gear for the Warrior class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

items.name: Noble's Trousers
items.summary: Noble's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
White trousers of superior craftsmanship. Worn by expatriated royalty.

A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

details: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

items.name: War Surgeon Trousers
items.summary: War Surgeon Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bloodstained trousers of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers.

Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception.

details: Dropped by Unnamed White Mask invader at the blood river of Mohgwyn Palace.

items.name: Thiollier's Trousers
items.summary: Thiollier's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: The dark trousers of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

details: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

notes: This item is part of Thiollier's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Trousers
items.summary: Nomadic Merchant's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Trousers of the nomadic merchants.

These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground.

Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

details: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

items.name: Bandit Boots
items.summary: Bandit Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leather boots worn by bandits.

Light for ease of movement, and supple for masking sound. In
trade, they offer little damage negation.

details: Starting gear for the Bandit class.
Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,000 Runes.

notes: The Bandit Boots are part of the Bandit Set.

items.name: Confessor Boots
items.summary:
Confessor Boots is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Confessor Set.
items.description:
Leather boots of the church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the
teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the
guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to
hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

details: Starting gear for the Confessor class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

items.name: Omenkiller Boots
items.summary: Omenkiller Boots is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Stiff leather boots worn by the Omenkillers.

details: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Gravebird Anklets
items.summary: Gravebird Anklets is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Stone anklets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

details: Found on a corpse leaning against one of the statues in the poison swamp, located past the cave north of Moorth Ruins.

notes: This item is part of the Gravebird Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Dancer's Trousers
items.summary: Dancer's Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Long, black trousers worn underneath the deep crimson dress of the Ranah dancers.

Enhances the power of dancing attacks.
effect_details: Enhances the power of dancing attacks by +2.5%.

details: Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Dancer's Set.

items.name: Foot Soldier Greaves
items.summary: Foot Soldier Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Metal greaves that have already been mended countless times. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

details: Chance to drop from Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

items.name: Common Soldier Greaves
items.summary: Common Soldier Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

acquisition.location: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Common Soldier Set.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Greaves
items.summary: Vulgar Militia Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excized from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

details: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Greaves
items.summary: Shadow Militiaman Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

notes: This item is part of the Shadow Militiaman Set.

items.name: Duelist Greaves
items.summary: Duelist Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

details: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

notes: Increases the wearer's target priority, making enemies far more likely to target the wearer at further distances.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
items.summary: Rotten Duelist Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot.

Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

details: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of Ordina, Liturgical Town in Consecrated Snowfield.

notes: Increases the wearer's target priority, making enemies far more likely to target the wearer at further distances.

items.name: Nox Greaves
items.summary: Nox Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Monastic greaves of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

details: Chance to drop from Nox Monk, Nox Swordstress, and Night Maiden enemies in Nokron and Nokstella.

items.name: Champion Gaiters
items.summary:
Champion Gaiters is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Champion Set.
items.description:
Gaiters formed only with leather straps. Common wear in the
badlands.

details: Starting gear for the Hero class.
Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

notes: These were originally called "Badland Gaiters" in the Closed Network Test.

items.name: Leather Leg Wraps
items.summary: Leather Leg Wraps is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Leg wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps. The addition of animal pelt keeps the wearer warm.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

details: Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear.
Also found on a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

notes: This item is part of the Highland Warrior Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Iron Rivet Greaves
items.summary: Iron Rivet Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength.

"I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

details: Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Iron Rivet Set and Red Bear Set.

items.name: Igon's Loincloth
items.summary: Igon's Loincloth is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Loincloth of the broken drake warrior Igon. Stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle, this scrap of cloth smells utterly foul.

details: Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline.

→ Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.)
→ This will make Igon appear just past the arena, exhaust his dialogue there until he gives Igon's Furled Finger.
→ Defeat Bayle the Dread at the top of the Jagged Peak (summoning Igon for the fight is optional).
→ After Bayle has been felled, return to the location where Igon gave his furled finger. As this item, along with several others, can now be recovered from his body.

notes: This item is part of Igon's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Ascetic's Ankle Guards
items.summary: Ascetic's Ankle Guards is an armor piece in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ankle guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

notes: This item is part of the Ascetic's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Chain Leggings
items.summary: Chain Leggings is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

details: Sold by Kalé

items.name: Godrick Soldier Greaves
items.summary:
Godrick Soldier Greaves is a leg armor in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Soldier Set.
items.description:
Greaves worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop by Godrick Soldier enemies.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Greaves
items.summary: Raya Lucarian Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Soldier enemies.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Greaves
items.summary: Radahn Soldier Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Greaves
items.summary: Leyndell Soldier Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Greaves
items.summary: Haligtree Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

items.name: Mausoleum Greaves
items.summary: Mausoleum Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

details: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Greaves
items.summary: Messmer Soldier Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

details: 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

notes: This item is part of the Messmer Soldier Set.

items.name: Exile Greaves
items.summary: Exile Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Damaged iron greaves. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

details: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

items.name: Kaiden Trousers
items.summary: Kaiden Trousers is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Trousers worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the moutaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

details: Chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

items.name: Land of Reeds Greaves
items.summary:
Land of Reeds Greaves is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Land of Reeds Set.
items.description:
Greaves wrapped in tough leather. Worn by warriors of
the Land of Reeds.

details: Starting gear for the Samurai class.
Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

items.name: White Reed Greaves
items.summary: White Reed Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by Inaba, head disciples of the great swordsman Okina.

The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothing more than to die by the sword.

details: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Ronin's Greaves
items.summary: Ronin's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

details: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

items.name: Eccentric's Breeches
items.summary: Eccentric's Breeches is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
The knight Jerren's breeches.

Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn.

And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

details: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

items.name: Freyja's Greaves
items.summary: Freyja's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Redmane Freyja at either of the following locations:
details: Specimen Storehouse - If the player chooses to kill her by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, as it is the first location where she's vulnerable to being attacked.

→ Freyja can also simply be completely ignored, then this item will be left behind where she once was, once the player has engaged with the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight at least once. With no need to engage with her in combat.

→→ Note that Freyja dying or disappearing before the player has recieved the Golden Lion Shield from her, makes that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough (outside of having it be left by another player during online play). The player can however simply refrain from killing Freyja until after they've received the shield.
Enir-Ilim - If the player chooses to give Freyja the Letter for Freyja key item at the Specimen Storehouse, without immediately killing her afterwards.
→ Freyja will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on her corpse, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

notes: This item is part of Freyja's Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Skirt
items.summary: Blue Silver Mail Skirt is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Chainmail skirt crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

details: Chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

items.name: Fire Monk Greaves
items.summary: Fire Monk Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

details: Chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Greaves
items.summary: Blackflame Monk Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

details: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

items.name: Zamor Legwraps
items.summary: Zamor Legwraps is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Legwraps worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants.

These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

details: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Black Knife Greaves
items.summary: Black Knife Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

details: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Greaves of Night
items.summary: Greaves of Night is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Bottomless greaves, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

details: Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol.

→ To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own. This elevator will first descend down to a stone bridge (which when followed, will progress towards the end of the dungeon) before automatically ascending back up again. Jumping back onto the jar-elevator as it ascends and staying on it until it reaches the top will eventually take the player to the section where this item can be found.

notes: This item is part of the Night Set.

items.name: Malenia's Greaves
items.summary: Malenia's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

items.name: Elden Lord Greaves
items.summary: Elden Lord Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield.

He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

details: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

items.name: Messmer's Greaves
items.summary: Messmer's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Black greaves of Messmer the Impaler.

On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.

"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

details: Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

notes: This item is part of Messmer's Set.

items.name: Knight Greaves
items.summary:
Knight Greaves is a leg armor in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Knight Set.
items.description:
Iron greaves of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

details: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Greaves
items.summary:
Vagabond Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Vagabond Knight Set.
items.description:
Greaves of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and
battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant
damage negation.

details: Starting gear for the Vagabond class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

items.name: Carian Knight Greaves
items.summary: Carian Knight Greaves is a piece of leg armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

details: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Godrick Knight Greaves
items.summary:
Godrick Knight Greaves is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Godrick Knight Set.
items.description:
Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time
has yet to dull their luster.

details: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Greaves
items.summary: Cuckoo Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

items.name: Redmane Knight Greaves
items.summary: Redmane Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Greaves
items.summary: Gelmir Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Greaves
items.summary:
Leyndell Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Leyndell Knight Set.
items.description:
Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Greaves
items.summary: Haligtree Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: Chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Greaves
items.summary: Mausoleum Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greaves worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

details: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

items.name: Black Knight Greaves
items.summary: Black Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

details: 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

notes: This item is part of the Black Knight Set.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Greaves
items.summary: Bloodhound Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Metal greaves of the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

details: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

items.name: Cleanrot Greaves
items.summary:
Cleanrot Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It's part of the Cleanrot Set.
items.description:
Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

details: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

items.name: Fire Knight Greaves
items.summary: Fire Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

details: 3% chance of dropping from Fire Knights.

notes: This item is part of the Fire Knight Set.

items.name: Death Knight Greaves
items.summary: Death Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Golden greaves of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.
effect_details: Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Incantations by +2%.
Enhances the power of Dragon Cult Skills by +2%.

details: Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer.
→ The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

→ Once at the bottom of the elevator, there will be large open room with a staired balcony on the eastern walls. Follow this balcony while keeping an eye on the guard rail, past the lionheaded imp until the path turns to the right. There will be an opening in the in the corner of the rail. This opening will lead to a drop down to a small ledge that'll immediately lead this hidden room.

notes: This item is part of the Death Knight Set.

items.name: Horned Warrior Greaves
items.summary: Horned Warrior Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Greaves of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. Shaped to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

acquisition.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim
details: 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Horned Warrior Set.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Greaves
items.summary: Divine Bird Warrior Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The great, sharp talons increase the force generated by kicks.
effect_details: Raises potency of kicking and stomping attacks by +5%.

details: 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

notes: This item is part of the Divine Bird Warrior Set.

infobox.effects: Raises potency of kicking and stomping attacks

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Greaves
items.summary: Oathseeker Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Oathseeker Knight greaves. Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

details: Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

notes: This item is part of the Oathseeker Knight Set and Leda's Set.

items.name: Raging Wolf Greaves
items.summary:
Raging Wolf Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Raging Wolf Set.
items.description:
Greaves worn by Vargram the Bloody Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

details: Murder Vargram the Raging Wolf.

notes: This item was originally called "Bloody Wolf Greaves" in the Closed Network Test and was part of the set worn by the test-only class, Bloody Wolf.

items.name: Hoslow's Greaves
items.summary: Hoslow's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Garish silver greaves decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

details: Murder Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

items.name: Twinned Greaves
items.summary: Twinned Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are two bodies and two minds, but a single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

details: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

items.name: Drake Knight Greaves
items.summary: Drake Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Black iron greaves by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

details: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

items.name: Blaidd's Greaves
items.summary: Blaidd's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Well-worn black greaves of the man-wolf Blaidd.

Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.

details: Obtained from Blaidd with the rest of his armor set after killing him at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline.

items.name: Briar Greaves
items.summary:
Briar Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Briar Set.
items.description:
Battered greaves from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

notes: Deals 18 Standard physical damage if colliding with an enemy when rolling.

items.name: Fingerprint Greaves
items.summary:
Fingerprint Greaves is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fingerprint Set.
items.description:
Iron greaves singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

details: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Rakshasa Greaves
items.summary: Rakshasa Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves of Rakshasa, soaked the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.
effect_details: Increases attack power +2%.
Reduces damage negation by -2%.

details: Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Rakshasa Set.

items.name: Royal Remains Greaves
items.summary: Royal Remains Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly resplenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

details: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

notes: Restores 2 HP per second when the wearer is at below 18% of their maximum health. The restoration effects stop once their health raises past the threshold.

items.name: All-Knowing Greaves
items.summary: All-Knowing Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

details: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

items.name: Royal Knight Greaves
items.summary: Royal Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

items.name: Rellana's Greaves
items.summary: Rellana's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description: Ornate greaves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

details: Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

notes: This item is part of Rellana's Set.

items.name: Maliketh's Greaves
items.summary: Maliketh's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Beast's greaves made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

details: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Banished Knight Greaves
items.summary: Banished Knight Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These greaves were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all acomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

details: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Greaves
items.summary: Night's Cavalry Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Pitch-black greaves thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

details: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Greaves of Solitude
items.summary: Greaves of Solitude is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Steel greaves of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

details: Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: This item is part of the Solitude Set.

items.name: Veteran's Greaves
items.summary: Veteran's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Old greaves that have seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

items.name: Scaled Greaves
items.summary: Scaled Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

details: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

items.name: Beast Champion Greaves
items.summary: Beast Champion Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Silver greaves engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

details: Received upon:
Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.
At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Greaves
items.summary: Tree Sentinel Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Golden greaves of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

details: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Greaves
items.summary: Malformed Dragon Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed golden greaves. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

details: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Crucible Greaves
items.summary: Crucible Greaves are leg armor in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

details: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.
Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

notes: Increases the damage of all Aspect of the Crucible Incantations, as well as Skill: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and Devonia's Vortex, by 4%.

items.name: Gaius's Greaves
items.summary: Gaius's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Black iron greaves made for Commander Gaius. A cruel joke, for he could not wear them.

Riding atop the boar he called his other half, Gaius was in fact a warrior of albinauric extraction.

details: Dropped from a wolf-riding Albinauric Archer near the Albinauric's Shack, which can be found by the road between Commander Gaius's arena and the Scadutree Chalice.

notes: This item is part of Gaius's Set.

items.name: Radahn's Greaves
items.summary: Radahn's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greaves depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

details: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Young Lion's Greaves
items.summary: Young Lion's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
The golden greaves worn by Radahn in his younger years. Worn by a fierce lion.

When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear—

"Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

details: Can be bought for 12000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

notes: This item is part of the Young Lion's Set.

items.name: Lionel's Greaves
items.summary:
Lionel's Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.

It is part of Lionel's Set.
items.description:
Rounded iron greaves. Worn by Lionel the Lionheated.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself her father.

details: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Bull-Goat Greaves
items.summary: Bull-Goat Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's greaves, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provide high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

details: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

notes: This is part of the Bull-Goat Set.
The Bull-Goat Armor is the heaviest leg armor piece in the game.

items.name: Verdigris Greaves
items.summary: Verdigris Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greaves made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

acquisition.location: & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:
details: Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever".

→ Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood. Here, this item can be safely recovered from his body, with no need for a fight.
Enir-Ilim - If the player selects "Put it behind you" when talking to Moore.
→ Moore will appear at the Cleansing Chamber as one of the potential enemies in the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.
→ Defeating the loyalists will make this item appear on his body, which can be found in the arena after the battle is won.

acquisition.location: / Scadu Altus - The player can also get this item from killing Moore when he invades as retribution for the murder of two forager brood members.
details: Note that Moore will not drop his bell bearing if killed in this manner, thus making that item inaccessible for the rest of the playthrough.

notes: This item is part of the Verdigris Set.
Can be sold to merchants for 500.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

items.name: Omen Greaves
items.summary: Omen Greaves is an armor piece found in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Malformed greaves resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, their form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence? What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all.

details: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

notes: Increases the damage of the Omen Bairn and the Regal Omen Bairn, as well as the heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks during the effect of Shriek of Milos, by 5%.

items.name: Fire Prelate Greaves
items.summary:
Fire Prelate Greaves is an armor piece in Elden Ring.

It is part of the Fire Prelate Set.
items.description:
Black iron greaves with the appearance of flames. Attire of
the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity.

details: Dropped by Fire Prelates.
